items.quote: EBITDA margin was 7% compared with 12.81% last year, while on a sequential basis, the margin improved by approximately 69 basis points from 6.30% in Q1.

items.statement: PAT margin 4.5% in Q2 vs 8.35% YoY, up from 4.21% sequentially
items.quote: PAT margin was 4.50% compared with 8.35% last year and 4.21% in previous quarter.

items.statement: Margin compression due to investments in new verticals, team expansion and tech infrastructure
items.quote: As we highlighted last quarter, the year-on-year movement in margin reflects the investments we have made in building the new verticals, expanding the team and strengthening our business and technology infrastructure.

items.statement: Infrastructure built for 1,000 team members; 13,000 sq ft Noida office accommodates 250-275, currently 110 seated
items.quote: Now the infrastructure, which is there currently is there for about 1,000 team members in the company. Now we have a 13,000 square feet plate office in Noida. That rental is there and it can accommodate about 250 to 275 employees. Now we have just about 110 who are sitting out of that office.

items.statement: 7 offices operational, each accommodating ~90 people
items.quote: Similarly, we have now 7 offices, which are up and running. All these offices are not those what you call it, work areas where there is a small little cabin. All these are offices which can accommodate at least 90 people per location.

items.statement: Headcount grew from 70-90 to 350+ in 6 months
items.quote: Now from 70 team members, we are at about 350 team members.

items.statement: Finance cost INR 1.8 crores in H1 FY27 vs INR 0.21 crores YoY due to higher turnover
items.quote: Currently, yes, we are paying about INR1.8 crores. We have paid INR1.8 crores as the interest, finance cost in the last H1.

items.statement: Not looking to raise funds currently; may consider after Main Board listing in 9-10 months
items.quote: As of now, we are not looking at raising any funds. We wish to concentrate currently on building the company during this year. And since we are just about 9 to 10 months away from Main Board, we may look at raising funds once we are into the main board.

items.statement: Government payment cycle comfortable; Punjab Yatra payments coming with minor delays
items.quote: I am very happy to state that the payment cycle is -- we are comfortable with the payment cycle, and we are doing -- we are focusing on the recovery, and we are doing quite a bit of business in this particular vertical.

items.statement: One government contract has 80% advance for NASA USA group trip
items.quote: There is one particular business where we have 80% advance, which is for a group which is going to NASA, USA.

items.statement: GMV INR 532.54 crores in Q2, INR 784.54 crores in H1 FY27
items.quote: Our GMV, which we started disclosing from Q1, stood at approximately INR532.54 crores for the quarter. For the half year, GMV stood at approximately INR784.54 crores.

items.statement: Revenue INR 204.53 crores in Q2, up 174.7% YoY and 41.7% QoQ
items.quote: Revenue from operations stood at INR204.53 crores in quarter 2 financial year '27 compared with INR74.46 crores in quarter 2 financial year '26, representing a 174.7% year-on-year growth. On a sequential basis, revenue increased from INR144.33 crores in quarter 1 to INR204.53 crores, the growth of around 41.7%.

items.statement: H1 revenue INR 348.86 crores, up 259% YoY
items.quote: For the half year, revenue from operation stood at INR348.86 crores from compared with INR97.08 crores in H1 FY26, the growth of around 259%.

items.statement: H1 PAT INR 15.42 crores, up 97% YoY
items.quote: For H1 FY27, PAT stood at INR15.42 crores compared with INR7.82 crores in H1 FY26, a growth of approximately 97% with a PAT margin of 4.38% compared with 7.93%.

items.statement: Cross-selling MICE, leisure, ticketing to 140 corporate clients' employees
items.quote: Now when we penetrate into a company for corporate business, for example, this 140 companies which have been added in our portfolio as our corporate customers, we get inroads to thousands of people who would travel, and we would get them as a prospective leisure customer.

items.statement: Existing 8-9 year MICE client now empaneled for corporate ticketing and SBT tool
items.quote: And we are now empaneled with them for their corporate ticketing. They have taken our SBT tool -- sorry, I forgot, our SBT tool. And we've created -- we've signed a contract with them, and there is a limit which has been created.

items.statement: Government business awarded to vendors with proven delivery track record
items.quote: What happens is that the government and institutional business is given to vendors who have delivered in past.

items.statement: Recognized by Ministry of Tourism via NIDHI as experienced MICE tour operator
items.quote: During the quarter, we were recognized by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India through the NIDHI as an experienced MICE Tour operator.

items.statement: Empaneled with IRCTC, Karnataka government undertaking, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, UP
items.quote: IRCTC, we have already been in impaneled, as you know. So this will keep going on. One more thing to add, we have also been in empaneled in government of Karnataka undertaking. So we have also been impaneled there.

items.statement: B2C OTA platform machtravel.com and mobile app in public beta since Aug 31
items.quote: On the B2C front, we opened machtravel.com and the Mach Travel mobile app for public beta listing on 31st August.

items.statement: B2C commercial launch timeline undefined; partnerships with airlines, consolidators, hotels ongoing
items.quote: It takes still time for the product to come to a launch stage. It will take a little time. I cannot define what is the period which we are looking at. There are a lot of new partnerships which we are doing with various airlines and the consolidators and the hotels and their consolidators.

items.statement: Inbound travel scaling will take time; participating in global fairs like WTM London, Dubai
items.quote: But for us to give you a trajectory that this is the kind of revenue we would expect and this is the time line would be very difficult at this stage. But having said that, we have a small inbound team, which is working very hard and their productivity is visible. And in next 6 months, I'm sure you would see growth in numbers.

items.statement: Featured in Dun & Bradstreet Business Enterprises of Tomorrow 2026 report
items.quote: In September, we were also featured among the leading SMEs of India in Dun & Bradstreet Business Enterprises of Tomorrow 2026 report.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY27 revenue guidance of Rs 342 crore and 60-70% growth target
items.quote: We have committed 60% to 70% growth, and it also reflects substantial boost to our growth trajectory here onwards.

items.statement: Confident of achieving FY27 guidance with H2 execution pickup and new POs
items.quote: So, the answer is yes, we are pretty confident in the second half of the year how this is going to shape up. So, there is no change in the guidelines we have given.

items.statement: EBITDA margin currently ~24%, targeting 25% for FY27 and 27-28% for FY28
items.quote: Currently, we are around 24% and this year we are targeting around 25%. So, next year it can be, you can say it is between 27%, 28%.

items.statement: Received LOI for largest payment solution order in India covering 300+ banks, valued in 10 digits
items.quote: In domestic market, I see a proud moment for NPST to have received an LOI for one of the largest payment solution order in the country. This will be built at a central level and it will provide access to 300 plus banks within 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: Signed one of largest global telecom service providers, multimillion-dollar deal contributing from Q4 FY27
items.quote: We not just signed one of the largest telecom service providers globally but it opened opportunities for 10 different countries as well as added a new segment altogether.

items.statement: First DPDP order from private bank and first digital currency order received in RegTech
items.quote: In RegTech, we got our first DPDP order from a private sector bank. And we also got our first order in digital currency.

items.statement: Active discussions in 5-15 international opportunities across 10+ countries, results expected Q3/Q4 FY27 and FY28
items.quote: So, it ranges between 5 to 15 odd right now, okay? So, which we see that the fruits will start coming in. So, you will see some this year for sure, Q3, Q4, and then you will see larger results in FY'28.

items.statement: TSP revenue contribution scaled from 15-20% to 80-85% over two years
items.quote: Our T SP revenue which contributed just about 15% to 20% of overall business two years back when we achieved our highest quarter has substantially scaled to contribute about 80% to 85% in this quarter

items.statement: Revenue split: SaaS 20-25%, license model 75-80%; one-time <50%, recurring >50%
items.quote: SaaS is 20%, 25% and license model is about 75%, 80%. Within that, there is a further break- up. There is AM C. In license also , t here are AMCs, there are change request, there are manpower

items.statement: Investing in AI productivity across departments targeting 40% improvement by March
items.quote: We have made several investments in AI productivity for each department, which will improve our response time and performance as per industry expectation in years to come.

items.statement: Acquisition discussions ongoing, may announce between current and next quarter using existing funds
items.quote: I think we are very close to a few things now. Maybe between this and the coming quarter, we will announce it.

items.statement: Sri Lanka telecom deal structured as 5-year revenue sharing model with per-transaction pricing ~15x India rates
items.quote: I can also give you an idea that while in India on a per transaction basis, whatever revenue we are generating, this is substantially per transaction almost about 15x more than what we would have it here in India.

items.statement: 300+ bank LOI is a 5-year deal; execution starts this quarter, revenue contribution from Q4/Q1
items.quote: The execution will start this quarter itself. And the overall execution is nine months. And I feel that we should start getting contribution from maybe Q4 or Q1 onwards.

items.statement: UPI MDR implementation delayed; positive incremental impact expected but cannot quantify yet
items.quote: So, I can assure you that once everything is done and the phase is complete, then for sure, it will have an impact, a positive and an upward impact the n what we have given you in projection

items.statement: Assessing NPCI Vyapaar Saksham scheme; will create new product opportunities for existing TSPs
items.quote: So, we are yet to assess that. Any such scheme which comes up when banks are supposed to absorb it. And when banks have to absorb it, for sure, it opens up gates for the existing TSP in banks.

items.statement: Consolidated income grew 50% YoY to Rs 72.95 crore in Q2; H1 income up 60% YoY to Rs 134 crore
items.quote: Our consolidated income has increased by 50% year-on-year. It has grown from Rs. 48.68 crores to about Rs. 72.95 crores, almost 20% increase from Q1 figure of Rs. 61.42 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA grew 17% YoY and 15% QoQ to ~Rs 16 crore; PAT grew 34% YoY and 20% QoQ to Rs 13.21 crore
items.quote: Our EBITDA too has shown 17% year-on-year growth and 15% Q-O-Q, almost Rs. 16 crores as on Q2. Finally, PAT has grown from Rs. 11 crores in Q1 to about Rs. 13.21 crores.

items.statement: Team of 350+ people focused on building organization
items.quote: There are more than 350 people focused in building the organization.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 20% to 25% for FY27 reiterated
items.quote: Despite the near-term challenges, we remain confident of achieving our previously communicated revenue growth guidance of 20% to 25% for FY27.

items.statement: No specific margin guidance provided; priority to protect Q2 FY27 EBITDA margins
items.quote: Given the ongoing geopolitical uncertainties and the limited visibility on how the situation may evolve, we believe it would be premature to provide specific margin guidance at this stage. However, our immediate priority is to protect and sustain the EBITDA margins achieved in Q2 FY27 while continuing to focus on operational efficiencies and cost optimization.

items.statement: Oil and gas sector demand slower than anticipated; power sector demand strong
items.quote: Additionally, higher crude oil prices and the deferment of capital expenditure across certain segments of the oil and gas industry have contributed to a slower-than-anticipated recovery in demand.

items.statement: EBITDA margin contracted 479 bps YoY to 10.6% in Q2 FY27 due to higher power, fuel and freight costs
items.quote: Our operating EBITDA margin for the quarter was 10.6% contracting by 479 basis point year-on-year from 15.38% in Q2 FY26. EBITDA driven by high power and fuel expenses coupled with increased freight cost.

items.statement: Power and fuel costs rose from 3% to 4.9% of revenue; freight from 1.4% to 2.9% of revenue
items.quote: The margin pressure was driven by higher power and fuel costs, which increased from 3% to 4.9% of revenue as well as the freight expenses, which also rose from 1.4% to 2.9% of revenue.

items.statement: Order book stands at around INR185 crores, entirely from seamless pipes
items.quote: Our order book stands at around INR185 crores right now. And that is all from seamless.

items.statement: Order book execution timeline is 4 to 5 months
items.quote: It's almost between 4 to 5 months.

items.statement: Capex incurred in H1 FY27 was approximately INR40 crores for machinery and solar plant
items.quote: Capex incurred H1 FY27 was approximately INR40 crores, primarily directed towards machinery shipments for the facility and solar power plant.

items.statement: Additional 8,000 MT welded expansion capex of INR45 crores to be spent in FY28
items.quote: So the total budgeted capex stands at INR45 crores. We expect to utilize this remaining investment during FY28.

items.statement: Additional 8,000 MT welded brownfield expansion to be commissioned in H1 FY28 (April-June)
items.quote: We expect this additional capacity to be commissioned during H1 FY28, taking our aggregate welding manufacturing capacity to 21,150 metric tons per annum.

items.statement: Seamless capacity utilization target of approximately 70% for FY27; optimal level 80-85%
items.quote: However, we remain confident of achieving approximately 70% capacity utilization for seamless product in FY27.

items.statement: Welded expansion will enable manufacturing up to 16 inches diameter pipes
items.quote: Our ongoing welded expansion will extend our technical capabilities to manufacture pipe of up to 16 inches in diameter, enabling us to participate in larger and more comprehensive turnkey packages.

items.statement: Intense competition limited ability to pass on higher input costs through price hikes
items.quote: Despite these cost increases, intense competition from private players limited our ability to pass on the additional costs through price hikes, resulting in largely stable realisations and consequent pressure on operating margins.

items.statement: Emerging inquiries from data centers, cooling infrastructure, HVAC, industrial water treatment and desalination
items.quote: We are already witnessing encouraging commercial interest and inquiries from emerging end user segments, particularly data center, cooling infrastructure, HVAC, industrial water treatment and desalination projects.

items.statement: RINA Marine audit completed in July 2026; final approvals awaited for European marine access
items.quote: On the business development front, we achieved another significant milestone by successfully completing the RINA Marine audit in July 2026, and the final approvals are currently awaited.

items.statement: Export sales 37% of Q2 FY27 revenue (INR55.1 crores); Europe affected by quota system but adapting
items.quote: In Q2 FY27, domestic sales contributed 63%, that is INR93.8 crores, while export sales accounted for 37% that is INR55.1 crores.

items.statement: Inventory levels elevated due to higher production and slower sales conversion; expect normalization in H2
items.quote: Inventory days have increased during the period, primarily due to higher production levels coupled with lower anticipated conversion of inventory into sales amid intense competition from private players. However, we expect inventory levels to gradually normalize during H2 supported by improved sales conversion, better alignment of production with market demand and reduction in inventory holding da

items.statement: Welded working capital cycle 130-140 days vs seamless 180-185 days
items.quote: Yes. The capital cycle is lower in welded compared to seamless. So in general, welded has a total cycle of around 130 to 140 days, whereas seamless has around 180, 185 days.

items.statement: Total gross borrowings INR229.2 crores as of September 30; peak debt expected at INR250 crores
items.quote: Total gross borrowings as of September 30 were INR229.2 crores.

items.statement: Peak debt expected at INR250 crores; no immediate plans to reduce debt
items.quote: Yes the peak debt is expected to be INR250 crores and no immediate plans to reduce it.

items.statement: Welded gross margins around 25% vs seamless 32-33%
items.quote: No. Gross margins of welded are lower at around 25%.

items.statement: Internal capex targets of 15-20% IRR and sustainable 15-20% ROCE long-term
items.quote: Whenever we put a capex our internal targets are 15% to 20% IRR but in the short it may vary due to geopolitical uncertainties but we remain confident that 15% to 20% ROCE is a sustainable long-term target as our newly created capacity ramp up.

items.statement: 60,000-70,000 MT new seamless capacity added by private players increasing competitive intensity
items.quote: The industry has witnessed additional seamless capacities of approximately 60,000 to 70,000 metric tons per annum, which leads to an increased competitive intensity.

items.statement: No change in anti-dumping duty policy on mother hollow pipes; new capacities are for hot and cold production
items.quote: No, sir, there has not been any change in the policies. The new capacities which we are talking about, which we have witnessed 60,000, 70,000, all of those capacities are for both hot production as well as cold production.

items.statement: European quota system shares anti-dumping duty across all importers; max 25% paid so far
items.quote: The whole system of the European Union is not that once the quota of 4,000 tons is full, you cannot import it or you have to pay 50%. The entire regulation which the government has done is the total number of tonnages, for example, if there is the import of 6,000 tons this quarter, then the duty will be shared among all the 6,000 tons of import among all customers, which will come to near, for exa

items.statement: BHEL tender timeline uncertain; domestic demand from power sector and non-NTPC customers
items.quote: The time line for new BHEL tenders remain uncertain, and we expect the tendering process to take some time, because we also don't have any time line from the end customers in BHEL both. However, we continue to have order opportunities in the domestic market with orders from customers other than NTPC already in hand, providing continuous visibility for our domestic business.

items.statement: H1 cash flow strong; expect further improvement when welded production starts in January
items.quote: So going forward, when the production starts, our revenue will boost up increasing the cash flow further. And which will be helpful for us to utilize the working capital cycle of the upcoming welded project.

items.statement: Targets 4x PAT by FY29 from FY26 base; expects 30-75% PAT growth annually
items.quote: Yes. That is our ultimate target. That is our ultimate target, which has been listed also. And all our strategies, everything is working towards 4x PAT. And we are confident. I mean, I am personally, we are on track, I can say. We are on track.

items.statement: Expects recurring business to cover 50% of costs in FY27, 75% next year, 100% in two years
items.quote: Currently, we are at, no, currently we are expected to touch about 50% and then 75% and then 100%.

items.statement: Expects 30%+ PAT growth year-on-year going forward
items.quote: you can definitely expect 30 plus increase on PAT year-on-year. And finally, achieving that, you know, target of 4x.

items.statement: AI adoption increasing enterprise cybersecurity focus; AI security deals in pipeline but none closed yet
items.quote: It is. It has just started off, but we haven't closed any AI security deal yet, but we are working on a few deals.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 8.7% in H1 FY27 from 7.5% in H1 FY26 and 3.8% in H2 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 8.7% from 7.5% in the corresponding period last year. On a sequential basis, EBITDA increased from INR2.3 crores in H2 '26 to INR7.8 crores in H1 '27, with the margin improving from 3.8% to 8.7%.

items.statement: PAT margin improved to 5.4% in H1 FY27 from 5% in H1 FY26
items.quote: PAT margin improved from 5% to 5.4% in H1 '26.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR92.7 crores as of September 2026, lower than historical levels due to strategic shift
items.quote: The company continues to focus on building a quality order pipeline with an order book of INR92.7 crores as of September 2026.

items.statement: Added 12 new clients in H1 FY27 across sectors and geographies
items.quote: We added 12 new clients during H1 27 across sectors and geographies, reflecting continued traction in enterprise cybersecurity solutions and services.

items.statement: Targeting 50 key accounts in Mumbai and 15 each in other cities to reduce concentration risk
items.quote: we identify 50 top clients in Bombay alone and from which we are expected to do about 80% of the business. We're not looking at Top 5 because it's too risky and putting all the eggs in five customers will be risky.

items.statement: Services mix improved to ~29% from 15% historically; target is to maintain and increase services share
items.quote: Currently, we are at about, earlier it used to be 85-15, 15 services and 85 product. Now, we are currently around about 71% and 29% and that will continue to -- we will maintain this and also increase it in coming years.

items.statement: Expanded from 1 location (Mumbai) to 5 domestic locations and 6 Gulf locations; added 8 vendors post-IPO (total ~10)
items.quote: We have increased our location, as I said, to five locations from one today. Five locations in India alone. And if I look at Gulf, it is six locations. We have added eight more vendors and we continue to add more vendors.

items.statement: Managed recurring services revenue at INR21.5 crores in H1 FY27; expects to add INR7 crores annually
items.quote: Today, we are our managed recurring services at about INR21.5 crores as of H1. Okay. Are you there? Yes. So, you can club both the things. So, for us, it's a combined revenue. And then we are expected to add about INR7 crores every year on the managed service.

items.statement: Recurring business added ~INR28 crores last year; targets 50-70% year-on-year growth in recurring business
items.quote: So, every year, we plan to add about, last year's number was about INR28 crores. So, we plan to add about 50% to 70% year-on-year our recurring business.

items.statement: Revenue declined 57% YoY to INR89.5 crores in H1 FY27 due to discontinuation of low-margin product sales to a leading bank
items.quote: revenue from operations stood at INR89.5 crores or INR895 million in H1 '27 compared to INR210 crores last year in H1 '26, reflecting a decline of 57% year-on-year. This moderation primarily reflects our conscious decision to discontinue lower-margin product sales to a leading banking client.

items.statement: Revenue grew 49% sequentially from INR59.9 crores in H2 FY26
items.quote: On a sequential basis, revenue grew 49% compared to INR59.9 crores in H2 '26.

items.statement: Sustenance contracts renewed with 8-10% annual price increases
items.quote: we go back and then sign a new contract with an increase of 8% to 10% year-on-year.

items.statement: Replacing large integrators (IBM, Wipro) in managed services due to quality issues; no competition in sustenance niche
items.quote: The big ones, we can name them IBM, Wipro and all that, they're all failing. So, we are replacing most of the big ones in many of our customers. Because big ones are large in numbers, they don't know whom to call there. And in terms of quality, they're failing miserably.

items.statement: In process of signing up with one of the largest system integrators in the US
items.quote: we are almost in the process of signing up with one of the largest system integrators in the US.

items.statement: Management acknowledges stock market negativity but commits to long-term value creation and plan execution
items.quote: whatever you're seeing at the stock market and everything, don't get worried. I've always maintained my status as a long term investment. So, but definitely in long term, you will make your money. And that's my personal commitment to all of you.

items.statement: Targets 60 million cubic meter overburden removal each in Q3 and Q4 FY27; reiterates FY27 guidance of 45%+ revenue growth and 35%+ EBITDA and PAT growth YoY
items.quote: Coming to the guidance point, we are targeting about 60 million cubic meter of overburden removal in each quarter 3 and quarter 4. The fleet, the capacity and the contracts are in place to do it. We reiterate that FY27 guidance we gave you in quarter 1. A growth of 45% plus in revenue, 35% plus both in EBITDA and PAT on year-to-year basis.

items.statement: Order book covers nine sites with average tenure of 2.5 years; participated in new tenders worth INR 11,000+ crores awaiting results; added INR 4,000 crores order book in H1
items.quote: Coming to the orders bid by the company, our order book covers nine sites with an average tenure of about 2.5 years. Beyond this, we have participated in net new tenders worth INR11,000 crores plus. We are awaiting the results.

items.statement: Capex of INR 584.88 crores in H1 FY27 to mobilize three new contracts and meet customer demand beyond targeted volumes; capex for current order book largely completed, further capex only if new contracts or volume extensions arise
items.quote: This is despite the capex of INR584.88 crores in the first half to mobilize the three new contracts we have got, that is Dhoptala II, Dudhichua II, and Jayant II and also to meet customer demands beyond targeted volumes.

items.statement: Fleet stands at 2,226 units as of date, up from 2,033 at June 30; targeting 105-110% volume growth on some contracts due to customer demand; capacity in place for 60 million cubic meter per quarter in H2
items.quote: Our fleet now stands at 2,226 units against 2,033 as at June 30th. Out of the net proceed of INR377.16 crores, INR371 crores have been utilized as per objects of the issue with no deviation.

items.statement: Normalized EBITDA margin improved to 16.60% in Q2 FY27 from 12.14% in Q2 FY26 (446 bps increase); H1 normalized EBITDA grew 48.7% YoY to INR 183.57 crores
items.quote: I will again reiterate to you that the margin of EBITDA for this quarter is 16.60% versus 12.14% last year. So basically, this has been the best H1 in the history of Caliber in terms of 92% growth and 446 bps of EBITDA margin rise.

items.statement: Achieved 100% diesel cost pass-through from customers; average LOA price INR 89-92 per cubic meter; pass-through received INR 184.10 crores in H1 and INR 78.39 crores in Q2; billing monthly or 15-day cycles
items.quote: Since we have now 100% pass through, so average price of our LOA is between INR89 to INR92. So now since our customers have given us the pass through, so now we are very much in control that we are not bothered with what will be the crude price in future.

items.statement: Coal demand rising with power demand; customers urging production beyond contracted volumes; power generation projected to grow 6.8% annually to FY30 with coal at 60% mix; strong query pipeline from private and government miners
items.quote: With the increased power demand, coal demand continues to rise. We expect this trend to continue. Seeing the rising demand, customers continue to urge us to increase our production beyond the contracted volume.

items.statement: IPO net proceeds INR 377.16 crores; INR 371 crores utilized as per objects with no deviation; strengthened net worth, reduced leverage, funded fleet expansion
items.quote: Out of the net proceed of INR377.16 crores, INR371 crores have been utilized as per objects of the issue with no deviation.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue mix: 88% coal mining services, 10% logistics, balance ancillary services; H1 coal extraction grew 41% YoY, overburden removal grew 72% YoY, logistics volumes grew 50% YoY
items.quote: Sector-wise revenue in the current quarter, 88% of revenue came from coal mining services, 10% came from logistics, and a balance from the other ancillary services.

items.statement: H1 FY27 overburden removal 76.49 million cubic meter (72% YoY growth); Q2 FY27 overburden removal 33 million cubic meter (109% YoY); H1 coal extraction 0.76 million ton (41% YoY); H1 logistics 9.83 million ton (50% YoY)
items.quote: In H1 '27, we removed 76.49 million cubic meter against 44.40 million cubic meter in H1 '26. Similarly, in quarter 2 '27, we removed 33 million cubic meter of overburden against 16 million cubic meter in the same quarter last year, a growth of 109% year-on-year.

items.statement: H1 cash profit (PAT + depreciation + ECL provision - lease rentals) grew 59.3% to INR 100.83 crores from INR 63.29 crores; Q2 cash profit INR 32.29 crores (4.7x YoY); H2 seasonally stronger with FY26 H2 revenue 1.7x H1 and EBITDA 2.5x H1
items.quote: Cash profit defined as PAT plus depreciation and amortization plus ECL provision reducing the lease rentals paid, the same Caliber Mining and definition we used in Q1, grew by 59.3% to INR100.83 crores from INR63.29 crores in H1

items.statement: Implemented AI platform 'Caliber Pulse 1' centralizing maintenance data for 200+ users with real-time vehicle breakdown monitoring; 'Pulse 2' (beta from Nov 1) integrating MIS and HR with AI layers and war rooms for efficiency control
items.quote: Caliber has formed Pulse 1. So, we have we have named it as Caliber Pulse 1. In Caliber Pulse 1, we have centralized all our maintenance data on a single portal that is being operated by more than 200 people. And that 200 users can use it through mobile, through website, that is through system login.

items.statement: Acknowledges competition but emphasizes AI-driven efficiency gains as differentiator; win rate on tenders expected to improve post-IPO with stronger financial capacity; bidding aggressively on INR 11,000+ crores new tenders
items.quote: Caliber has been one of them, and from last 6 months, Caliber is very aggressively focusing on implementing AI into the operational efficiency, maintenance efficiency, and finding out what more additions can be done by adding up AI.

items.statement: Monsoon seasonality impacts Q2 operations (haul road damage, fewer working days); H2 historically stronger with uninterrupted operations; diesel price volatility mitigated by 100% pass-through; execution risk on new tenders and volume exten
items.quote: And why rainy season is a weaker season, sir? The only simple reason is whenever a rain happens, it spoils the complete haul road and other activities at the mine. And whenever we restart the work, we have to repair the road and other activities, and it increases the cost.

items.statement: Sahyadri EBITDA margin target 23-24% over four to five years from acquisition
items.period: four to five years from acquisition
items.quote: we expect Sahyadri to get to, say, 23%, 24% margin over a four to five-year period from the point of acquisition, is what the overall guidance that we had given.

items.statement: Gurugram greenfield Phase 1 planned for 500 beds, construction completion in three to four years
items.quote: Phase 1 of the project is planned for 500 beds, with construction expected to complete in about three to four years.

items.statement: Kinder Hospital acquisition completed, repositioning as neighborhood multi-specialty hospital
items.quote: We are pleased to inform you that the transaction has been completed. We will soon commence work to reposition the facility as a neighborhood multi-specialty hospital, further enhancing our reach in the fast-growing area of

items.statement: H2 FY27 bed additions 440-500 beds including one greenfield and brownfield; FY28 additional 100 beds brownfield; total 550 beds over H2 FY27 and FY28
items.quote: For H2, we are expecting almost 440-500 beds, which includes one greenfield and brownfield. In FY28, there is a brownfield, around 100 beds will be added in that. So overall in H2 plus next year, around 550 beds.

items.statement: Kanakapura and Yelahanka greenfields each added 150 beds, current occupancy ~100 beds each
items.quote: 150 each in both these places. 150 each while we added, but I think the occupancy has not reached 150, right, in both these places.

items.statement: Sahyadri Hadapsar 50 beds to be added in Q3 FY27
items.quote: Hadapsar will come up in Q3 this financial year.

items.statement: Mumbai Juhu 602 beds, Raipur Phase 1 350 beds, commissioning starting with one-third capacity
items.quote: In Raipur, we have 350 beds in Phase 1, and we have the ability to go to 500 beds plus. In Mumbai, Juhu, we have 602 beds, which would be the capacity there.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 network EBITDA margin 26% including Sahyadri, 27% excluding Sahyadri
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin, excluding Sahyadri, was 27%, and at the network level, which includes Sahyadri, it was 26% for the quarter.

items.statement: Sahyadri Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 19.5%, up from 17.5% in Q1 FY27 and 15.5% in FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin is at 19.5% for the quarter. It is an improvement of over 200 basis points over Q1 of this year. You might recall in Q1 of this year, our margin was 17.5%. In Q2, the margin in Sahyadri is 19.5%, and it is in contrast to FY26, where the whole year margin was 15.5%.

items.statement: Kanakapura EBITDA margin 25%, Yelahanka 24% within first year of operations
items.quote: I am very happy to inform you that our Q2 EBITDA margin at Kanakapura, since its launch just over a year ago, is today at 25%. A 25% EBITDA margin in our South Bangalore Kanakapura Hospital, just over one year old. In Yelahanka, which is less than a year old, has already reached EBITDA margin of 24%.

items.statement: Electronic City Q2 FY27 EBITDA loss INR13 crores, revenue more than doubled from July to September
items.quote: Electronic City, quarter 2 has seen an EBITDA loss of INR13 crores, but I think it's ramping up quite well. Maybe if you want more color, Karthik can throw. We started this facility towards the end of July, maybe the first week of August. So already, whatever revenue we did in July, we more than doubled it in September.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 inpatient volumes up 35% YoY, outpatient volumes up 27% YoY
items.quote: Inpatient volumes increased by about 35% and outpatient volumes by 27% year-on-year.

items.statement: Network average occupancy 70.7% in Q2 FY27 vs 65% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Average occupancy across the network was 70% during the quarter compared to 65% in the first quarter of this year.

items.statement: Sahyadri occupancy improved to 67% in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Sahyadri Hospitals. While occupancy improved nicely to 67%,

items.statement: Oncology drug price capping impact negligible as controlled drugs are a small fraction of 12% oncology revenue
items.quote: onco revenue for the network is about 12% currently, and the chemotherapy is a fraction of that. And within that, the drugs which are controlled is again a subtraction. So we don't expect anything adverse to happen from this drug price capping.

items.statement: Centers of excellence (CONGO-R) revenue contribution 64.2% in H1 FY27, oncology/neurology/orthopedics growing ~43%
items.quote: Our centers of excellence, that is managing high-acuity care in cardiology, oncology, neurology, gastroenterology, orthopedics, and renal sciences, which we sort of in a short form call CONGO-R, continued to grow robustly, with their revenue contribution was 64.2% in the first half of this year.

items.statement: Cash and TPA payer mix ~80% stable; government schemes ~13-14%; East India government volumes temporarily down due to Swasthya Sathi transition to Ayushman Bharat
items.quote: Our government business is around 13%-14%, which also helps in faster turnaround of beds as well. So we are fairly comfortable, and as and when the right amount of volumes and the quality revenue comes up, we are fully invested in it to take it ahead.

items.statement: ARPOB ex-Sahyadri INR77,000/day (+8% YoY), network ARPOB INR70,600/day; Sahyadri ARPOB INR44,100 (-2% QoQ) due to higher medical mix
items.quote: Excluding Sahyadri, our average revenue per occupied bed per day is at about INR77,000 in quarter 2, which is a growth of over 8% versus last year. At a network level, the ARPOB per day is about INR70,600 per day.

items.statement: Average length of stay 2.8 days, industry-leading
items.quote: This is despite maintaining an industry-leading length of stay of only 2.8 days.

items.statement: Finance costs increased sequentially despite debt repayment on 15th September; benefit to reflect from Q3
items.quote: So the finance costs, actually the debt has got repaid only on 15th September, Alankar. It was only in the last you will have got the benefit of only in the last 15 days. The real benefit of the interest cost coming down will start coming from Q3, because the debt was carried almost up to the full quarter.

items.statement: Sahyadri insurance renegotiations ongoing at contractual inflation rates; rebranding to Manipal Hospitals and legal entity change required for better pricing
items.quote: Currently, the entity remains Sahyadri Hospitals Private Limited, so the entity name remains the same. The owners have changed. Just because of change of owners, insurance will not sort of come about and give us better pricing in Pune.

items.statement: East India government scheme volumes temporarily down due to Swasthya Sathi transition; expected to normalize
items.quote: the reduction in volume is because of the schemes changing over, the Swasthya Sathi scheme getting changed over to the Ayushman Bharat or its equivalent scheme in the state. We would expect that transition to get concluded fully.

items.statement: No forward EBITDA guidance provided; H2 FY27 started well with October performance strong
items.quote: We do not yet give guidance, forward-looking guidance on the numbers. The past trend that we have on H1 and H2 can be used for you to model how the current year will pan out. But we are fairly confident on how H2 will pan out. October has also started well.

items.statement: Targets capacity growth of 40% and revenue growth of at least 50% annually
items.quote: Yeah, we expect our capacity to increase by 40-50%, 40% actually, and revenue by at least 50%. That is what we are targeting for.

items.statement: Confident of achieving more than 45% revenue growth in FY27
items.quote: We are very confident on achieving more than 45% revenue this year.

items.statement: Expects EBITDA margins to stabilize around 19-19.5% long term
items.quote: See, again, that would be sustainable to around these numbers, around 19, 19.5%. With economies of scale, it can go a little higher also.

items.statement: Targets online channel share of 20-22% of revenue by end of FY27 and ~30% by mid next year
items.value: 20-22% by year end, ~30% mid next year
items.quote: by end of this year, we our target is approx to go at approximately 20-22% of the entire business of the monthly business. So, by end of next year, I would say it would reach somewhere around 30%.

items.statement: Aims to increase distributor count to more than 150 by end of FY27
items.quote: by end of this year, we are aiming it for more than 150 distributors.

items.statement: Targets own brand revenue share of 65% in 3-4 years from current ~45%
items.quote: So, we would expect in next 3 to 4 years, the ratio would be 65% in our own brand as compared to ODM and OEM.

items.statement: IPO-funded expansion of 31 lakh units to go live in Q4 FY27, taking annual capacity to ~103 lakh units
items.quote: Moreover, the IPO fund funded 31 lakhs units expansion will go will be going live in Q4 of this year, taking us to approximately 103 lakh units per year.

items.statement: Additional 30-40% capacity expansion possible on current land with ~20-25 crore capex
items.quote: And for that additional funds would be required would be somewhere around 20, 25 crores.

items.statement: Current annual capacity 72 lakh units; running at ~16 crore monthly revenue in November
items.quote: We are now currently at 72 lakh bottles per year and in November, we're running at about 16 crores of monthly revenue.

items.statement: February capacity addition ramped to 95% efficiency by May; new lines take 2 months to reach 85-90% efficiency
items.quote: jo hum logon ne apna February ke andar capacity increase kiya tha, it took us approximately again the same timing by May first week we have started utilizing the same at 90% of the efficiencies, and currently, we are utilizing the same at 95% of the efficiencies.

items.statement: Revenue potential at full 103 lakh capacity is ~23-24 crore per month
items.quote: So, revenue potential hai for the new for from the new lines, that can take us to a revenue of approximately 23 to 24 crores.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded ~447 bps sequentially in H1 due to lower outsourcing (6.5% vs 11-12%), higher value-added mix (23% vs 19%), ~8% price hike, and in-housing of job work
items.quote: The biggest was, earlier we were outsourcing certain items. We were in We were making around 88% of the product in-house, whereas 11 to 12% we were outsourcing. In the H1, we by increasing the capacities, we were outsourcing only 6.5% of the items.

items.statement: EBITDA margin by channel in H1: OEM ~18%, distributor brand ~20%, online ~21%
items.quote: approximately 18% is coming from the OEM business, of the EBITDA margins, and around 20% is coming from our own brand for the distributor network, whereas around 21% is coming from our this online business segment.

items.statement: Employee cost rose to ~8.75% of sales in H1 from ~7.25%; expected to stabilise near current level (+/-0.5%)
items.quote: Er in terms of percentages, yes. It would be somewhere around here and there only. 0.5% would be up from here.

items.statement: Industry supply-constrained; few Indian players can make vacuum bottles economically; demand not a constraint
items.quote: Currently, the market is supply-constrained. Not many people are able to make these bottles in India.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty (+20-25%), BIS norms, and higher freight/dollar making Chinese imports uneconomical
items.quote: First is anti- dumping duties. So, basically, it has made the imports costlier by at least 20, 25%. Secondly, because of the BIS norms the government has made sure there's no cheap imports happening from China to India or from anywhere in the world to India.

items.statement: Value-added/novelty products share increased to >23% from ~19%; planning back-to-school SKUs in H2 FY27
items.quote: Also, the product mix that we are offering, we have focused towards more value-added products and novelty products. Earlier it was around 19%, now the contribution is more than 23% of the same.

items.statement: Plans to launch stainless steel tiffin/bento boxes via trading in H2 FY28; will manufacture in-house once revenue share exceeds 5%
items.quote: we are planning to launch it as soon as possible. We are trying to find good sourcing partners, good, reliable sourcing partners for us initially. So, the idea is we'll be launching that maybe in H2 of next year. And usme hum log pehle trading karne wale hain

items.statement: Some online-only brands sourced 100% from Maharaja; legacy brands source 15-40% of their needs
items.quote: there are brands for which we are supplying 100% and there are brands for which we are providing as low as 15%.

items.statement: Competitors Cello/Borosil adding capacity but lack Maharaja's SKU breadth (200+ SKUs) and design patents (5); would take 3-4 years to match scale
items.quote: it would be difficult for anyone to get that kind of scale and SKU that we're operating at. It will take, Okay. maybe three years, four years, I'm not sure what the of the timing, but it will definitely take them enough time to get that kind of scale.

items.statement: Inventory days not expected to exceed 90; debtor cycle 45-55 days; creditor cycle 55-65 days; no funding needed for 50% growth
items.quote: So, we expect like our working capital like our inventory days not to go beyond 90 days. Currently, it is of similar nature. Whereas, our debtor and creditor is of almost at similar par level like debtor cycle is approximately around 45 to 55 days, whereas the creditor cycle is also around 55 to 65 days.

items.statement: Repaid all short-term borrowings (~22.7 crore); debt-equity ratio 0.04
items.quote: We repaid all of our short-term borrowings, that is of approximately 22.7 crore and currently our debt equity ratio is 0.04.

items.statement: No incremental funding required for 50% growth; short-term borrowings available if needed for 100% growth
items.quote: for the current 50% growth, I don't see any funding requirement. If and if there is any small requirement we can take it we can take up short term borrowings as and when required.

items.statement: Focus on domestic market; export consideration only after fulfilling India distribution in 2-3 years
items.quote: once we have fulfilled the entire demand in India for our own brand for distribution network, then we can think of geographical expansion in terms of exports. Currently, we are focused towards more of Indian demands.

items.statement: Market share 2% currently; long-term vision 10% by FY31
items.quote: currently we are at 2% of the market share and it's our long-term vision of say 6 years from here to get to 10%.

items.statement: Implemented ~8% price increase due to war-related turmoil; contributed to gross margin expansion
items.quote: And in spite of all this, we have also increased the prices in the market because of the turmoil happening because of the war situation in the past, hum logo ne lagbhag 8% ka price increase kiya tha.

items.statement: BIS norms and anti-dumping duties (March 2025) created structural advantage for domestic organized manufacturers
items.quote: In 2025, government has introduced BIS and anti-dumping duties in most of our categories. And since we were in the manufacturing business from last 5 years, we got huge advantage of the situation.

items.statement: Replacement cycle varies; kids' bottles replaced every 2-3 months; Gen Z treats bottles as lifestyle products with frequent trend-driven replacement
items.quote: Sir, aap isko is tarike se samajhiyega ki agar ghar mein jitne bacche hain na unko har do mahine mein teen mahine mein naya bottle chahiye hota hai.

items.statement: Birla Opus targets 50% YoY revenue growth for FY27 and double-digit revenue market share in H2 FY27
items.quote: We have said on a year-on-year basis, we will deliver 50% growth. We maintain that guidance, and you can do the maths based on that.

items.statement: Birla Opus aims to reach ₹10,000 crores brand by exit of FY28
items.quote: Our ambition remains unchanged, to become India's second-largest decorative paints company and build ₹10,000 crores brand by exit of FY28.

items.statement: Birla Pivot targets ₹12,000 crores revenue for full year FY27
items.quote: The business annualized revenue run rate crossed ₹11,000 crores this quarter and aims to cross ₹12,000 crores of revenue for full year FY27.

items.statement: Birla Pivot remains on track to reach break-even in H2 FY27
items.quote: The business remains on track to reach break-even in H2 FY27.

items.statement: Standalone capex guidance maintained at ₹3,157 crores for FY27
items.quote: For FY27, we earmarked a standalone capital expenditure of ₹3,157 crores, of which ₹1,022 crores were invested in H1 FY27.

items.statement: Paints capex overall number remains at ₹10,000 crores
items.quote: The overall number remains at ₹10,000 crores, 1% this side or that side.

items.statement: Decorative paints industry grew 16-17% in H1 FY27 with 8-9% from rate and 7-8% from volume
items.quote: The first half has surprised us as far as the industry is concerned. It is between 16%-17% industry is growing on a H1 this year versus last year H1, which has a constituent support 8%-9% by rate and remaining 7%-8% by volume.

items.statement: Industry expected to grow 15-20% in H2 FY27
items.quote: We expect the industry to continue to have this degree of growth between 15%-18%, or I will give a slightly wider range of 15%-20% in H2.

items.statement: Birla Opus H1 FY27 revenue grew 50% YoY to ₹3,000 crores; Q2 volume grew 20% YoY
items.quote: For H1FY27, the revenue stood at one shot of ₹3,000 crores, growing 50% year-on-year. This quarter, Birla Opus recorded a revenue of ₹1,337 crores with a year-on-year growth of 35%. The H1 volume grew by 33% and quarter 2 volume by 20% on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: October volume growth far higher than average H1 YoY growth
items.quote: Volume growth this October is far higher than the average Y-o-Y growth in H1.

items.statement: Birla Opus reduced price gap vs market leader to 2-4% in September from higher levels earlier
items.quote: confidence on brand and product quality grew, we took a bold call to reduce our price versus market leader in a step-by-step process. We believe that in the month of September, our prices are within 2%-4% distance, excluding 10% impact versus the monopoly player

items.statement: VSF Q2 margin around ₹22/kg; Q3 expected range-bound, Q4 uncertain
items.quote: I think I would say quarter 3 would be also range-bound, but I can't give you an exact number.

items.statement: Chemicals: caustic pricing under pressure, chlorine demand-supply improving, epoxy value chain margin compressed
items.quote: Caustic pricing remains under pressure. We do believe that chlorine demand-supply dynamics will improve. I do not see the epoxy value chain changing significantly this quarter, but I suspect that fourth quarter will be a bit better.

items.statement: Birla Opus has 60,000+ project sites at various stages including pipeline; institutional volume to accelerate in H2
items.quote: The company has 60,000 plus project sites at various stages of work, including in pipeline, and we expect institutional volume to accelerate in H2.

items.statement: Paints capex spent slightly short of ₹10,000 crores overall; current spend on franchise model and tinting machines
items.quote: Our overall capex spend was ₹10,000 crores. I think we have little, short, ₹3 billion-₹4 billion, a little short we have spent up till now. The current capex is primarily for building our franchise model and tinting machines to certain part.

items.statement: Cellulosic fiber specialty capacity expansion: Phase I 55,000 tpa nearly complete procurement; Phase II 110,000 tpa EC application advanced
items.quote: Given its growth opportunities, we are expanding here, especially in specialty fiber segment with a planned capacity of 165,000 tons per annum in two phases. Phase I of 55,000 tons per annum has nearly completed all the procurement deliveries. For phase II of 110,000 tons per annum, the environmental clearance application is at advanced stage of submission.

items.statement: Chemicals: 50,000 tpa CPVC plant commissioned August 2026; 50,000 tpa epichlorohydrin plant commissioned October 2026; chlorine integration expected to improve to 67%
items.quote: In chlorine derivatives, two key projects at Vilayat came on stream recently. The 50,000 tons of CPVC plant was commissioned in August 2026, and 50,000 tons epichlorohydrin plant was commissioned in October 2026. As capacity ramped up across these projects, our chlorine integration is expected to improve to 67%.

items.statement: UltraTech on track to achieve 242.9 million metric tons capacity by March 2028
items.quote: The business remains firmly on track to achieve 242.9 million metric tons of capacity by exit of March 2028.

items.statement: Renewable capacity expanded 269 MW YoY to 2.2 GWp; post-Sprng acquisition operational and under construction capacity to reach ~10 GWp; target 20 GWp
items.quote: The renewable business capacity expanded by 269 megawatts on year-on-year basis, and total capacity now stands at 2.2 GWp. Happy to share that we have got CCI approval on acquisition of Sprng, and we remain committed to close the transaction in the current calendar year. Post-acquisition, the total capacity, operational and under construction, would reach about 10 gigawatts of peak capacity. The b

items.statement: Global CSF price Q2 FY27 average USD1.85/kg, up 23% YoY
items.quote: Subsequently, global CSF price has now risen for four consecutive quarters, with the Q2 FY27 average at USD1.85/ kg, up 23% year-on-year.

items.statement: Caustic CFR Southeast Asia prices at five-year low USD390/ton; domestic prices firm due to stable demand and rupee depreciation
items.quote: Caustic prices were soft this quarter. CFR Southeast Asia prices stood at five-year low levels of USD390/ ton. However, stable domestic demand and rupee depreciation resulted in some firmness in domestic prices.

items.statement: Chlorine prices improved in Gujarat market, near zero or slightly positive; domestic chlorine prices improved due to local demand-supply
items.quote: We have seen an improvement in chlorine prices, particularly in the Gujarat market, where you could even argue that it is almost not negative anymore or maybe just slightly negative or slightly positive. Across India, that is a different picture because of local market conditions, right? Basically, chlorine prices have improved and possibly will remain improved because of local demand and supply.

items.statement: Birla Opus portfolio: 239 products, 2,300+ SKUs; premium/luxury ~63% of sales value; waterproofing 2x revenue growth
items.quote: Our pipeline continues to develop with focus on differentiated offering, superior product performance, and premiumization. Importantly, our growth is not limited to few categories. We are seeing encouraging traction across the portfolio, with premium and luxury portfolio still contributing approximately 63% of our sales value despite a weak quarter. Our waterproofing portfolio has been particularl

items.statement: Birla Pivot: retail business already profitable at EBITDA level; integrated financing via Pivot Vault and bank/NBFC partnerships
items.quote: The retail business is already profitable at the EBITDA level, providing an encouraging validation of the underlying model. Another important differentiator is the integrated financing ecosystem being developed through Pivot Vault and partnerships with leading banks and NBFCs.

items.statement: Birla Opus combined market share with Birla White Putty at early teens; targeting double-digit revenue market share in H2 FY27 with Birla Opus alone
items.quote: Combined market share, including Birla Opus and Birla White Putty, remains at early teens, bridging the distance with existing number two. Our ambition now is to take the progress further with a clear focus on reaching double-digit revenue market share in H2FY27 with Birla Opus alone.

items.statement: CCI approval received for Sprng acquisition; committed to close in current calendar year
items.quote: Happy to share that we have got CCI approval on acquisition of Sprng, and we remain committed to close the transaction in the current calendar year.

items.statement: Birla Opus secondary volume (sell-out) grew 34% YoY vs primary sales 20% YoY, indicating dealer inventory depletion
items.quote: The reported secondary volume through contractor-painter scans grew by 34% year-on-year versus primary sales volume, which grew by only 20%, as reported in revenue briefing earlier. This indicates that the inventory of our dealers is fast depleting, and the same was therefore reflected in a strong October sales.

items.statement: Standalone cash profit Q2 FY27 ₹3,968 crores, up 2.5x YoY
items.quote: Also to share that cash profit for the quarter stood strong at ₹3,968 crores, up 2.5x on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: UltraTech dividend ~₹4,000 crores received in standalone, eliminated in consolidated
items.quote: The dividend from UltraTech of nearly ₹4,000 crores is cash received, which is accounted in standalone, however, gets eliminated in consolidated results.

items.statement: Sprng acquisition CCI approved; post-acquisition renewable capacity ~10 GWp; target 20 GWp
items.quote: Happy to share that we have got CCI approval on acquisition of Sprng, and we remain committed to close the transaction in the current calendar year. Post-acquisition, the total capacity, operational and under construction, would reach about 10 gigawatts of peak capacity. The business now aims to reach 20 gigawatts of capacity.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue Q2 FY27 ₹50,105 crores, up 26% YoY; trailing 12-month ₹194,234 crores
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue for Q2FY27 stood at the highest ever of ₹50,105 crores, up 26% year-on-year, driven by strong all-round performance across our businesses. On a trailing 12-month basis, consolidated revenue stood at ₹194,234 crores.

items.statement: Aditya Birla Capital revenue ₹13,990 crores, up 32% YoY
items.quote: Financial services subsidiary, Aditya Birla Capital, delivered a strong performance during quarter 2 of FY27, with revenue as consolidated in Grasim was higher by 32% year-on-year to ₹13,990 crores.

items.statement: Chemicals margins subject to geopolitical events, caustic oversupply from China, Middle East aluminum refinery outages, methanol disruption
items.quote: Something may happen somewhere geopolitically, and it will change the dynamics of the industry, right? Please take any kind of statement here with a big dose of caution. Some of these drivers are not in the hands of manufacturers, right? There are bigger factors at play.

items.statement: Capex target INR 25,000 crores for FY27; INR 10,000 crores already spent in H1
items.quote: we have already done INR 10,000 crores of capex, and we are on track to complete nearly INR25,000 crores of capex for the year.

items.statement: Renewables capacity addition target 2.5 GW for FY27; missed Q1 and Q2 targets but expect to meet full-year target
items.quote: we expect that this year target is 2.5 GW of capacity addition, and we will be able to meet that.

items.statement: Board approved 1,800 MW pumped hydro project at Shirwata with INR 11,871 crores investment, 75% debt and 25% equity
items.quote: We have also taken a decision today to add 1,800 MW of pumped hydro project in Shirwata near Lonavala. This will be with an investment of INR 11,871 crores and will be financed through 75% of debt and 25% equity.

items.statement: Bhivpuri pumped storage expected operational H1 CY2029; Shirwata expected CY2031
items.quote: The Bhivpuri project, we expect that it will become operational in first half of calendar year 2029, and Shirwata will get commissioned in Calendar year 2031.

items.statement: Power demand grew 10-11% in Q2 FY27 and 12% in October YoY due to weak monsoon and heat wave
items.quote: this has led to nearly 10% to 11% growth in the last quarter. And we find that momentum continues even in the month of October, when we have seen nearly 12% growth on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 PAT INR 1,652 crores, up 33% YoY; EBITDA up 5% YoY; Revenue up 26% YoY
items.quote: We have reported our highest-ever quarterly profit after tax of INR1,652 crores, which is an increase of 33% year-on-year compared to INR1,245 crores in the corresponding period last year. This growth has been based on excellent performance by all our businesses. EBITDA has increased by 5% on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: RE Genco run-rate EBITDA INR 4,500 crores per annum for 7.1 GW capacity; H1 EBITDA INR 2,231 crores
items.quote: RE Genco, our YTD number is INR2,231 crores so INR4,500 crores per annum.

items.statement: RE curtailment 11% in Q2 vs 8.8% in Q1; expect improvement as connectivity lines come online
items.quote: In quarter one, we had about 8.8% of curtailment. In quarter two, there's about 11% of curtailment. I think if you look at industry, there has been a curtailment throughout, and we're also facing the issue.

items.statement: Mundra SPPA signed with Gujarat, filed at CERC; advanced discussions with two other states; expect conclusion by December; billing under SPPA for all five DISCOMs
items.quote: We have signed the SPPA with Gujarat, and it has been filed in CERC, and it is now reserved for order. We are in discussion with all the other four states. Two states, we are in a very advanced stage of discussion, and we expect that we will be able to conclude that before December.

items.statement: Delhi regulatory assets up due to lack of full quorum; Supreme Court advised amortization over six years till 2031; expect tariff revisions in FY28
items.quote: Regulatory assets have gone up because in Delhi, there was no full quorum of the regulatory commission. Now that the full quorum is there, we expect that in this year, they will come up with the true-up orders and will provide the increase in tariff so that the regulatory asset will be amortized.

items.statement: No decision yet to shift solar module manufacturing from mono PERC to TOPCon; small TOPCon line exists; ingot/wafer plant approvals received, work starting this month, operational by March 2028
items.quote: On the ingot and wafer plant, we have now received all the approvals that are required to start the work. We expect to start the work in this month, and we expect that by March 2028, the plant will be fully operational. As far as the existing solar cell and module plant, we have not taken steps to shift to the TOPCon line.

items.statement: Kleros arbitration: Singapore Court of Appeal hearing listed for 19 Jan; shares pledged to lenders; expect legal process 3-6 months; no provision made as case considered strong
items.quote: We have now approached the Court of Appeal or the Supreme Court of Singapore, and the matter is now listed for 19th of January. We strongly believe that we have a good case, both on merit as well as on law. We expect that we will be able to succeed in the Supreme Court.

items.statement: H1 capex INR ~10,000 crores, of which INR ~6,000 crores to renewables; RE business cash balance INR 1,000-1,400 crores as of September
items.quote: In H1, we did about close to about INR10,000 crores of capex, and roughly about INR6,000 odd crores went to the RE business, renewable business, and the remaining is still among various businesses that we have.

items.statement: Impairment of INR 96 crores for Georgia asset; same as previous year, leftover amount after failed revival attempt
items.quote: No, it is the same impairment. This was the leftover amount of INR96 crores. We were trying to revive some of the operating things over there, which we have not been able to do that.

items.statement: Did not bid for South Kalamb HVDC project; evaluating HVDC opportunities but limited OEMs with required technology; need back-to-back OEM arrangements
items.quote: We did not bid for the HVDC project, and we have been examining the HVDC project, especially in terms of the OEMs, and there are not many OEMs who have the type of technology which are being bid out.

items.statement: Parallel licensing in distribution: awaiting government clarity via Electricity Act amendments or new rules; regulators holding decisions pending notifications
items.quote: I think much more clarity is required from the various state governments as well as from the central government in terms of whether it is through amendment to the Electricity Act or amendment in the new electricity rules and tariff rules which are coming.

items.statement: BESS VGF scheme: working with Tata AutoComp (battery assembly) and Agratas (cell manufacturing); expect better supply chain control with local cell production
items.quote: We work very closely with Tata AutoComp, who sources the cell from China and makes the battery set, including the battery management part of it. We do expect that going forward, many of these cells will get manufactured in India also, including the plant that is being set up by another Tata Group company, Agratas.

items.statement: Ingot/wafer plant equipment orders not yet placed; examining implications of China's proposed technology export controls; expect clarity by end November
items.quote: We have not placed the order as yet. We are definitely examining the implication, and there is also a rethink that is happening in the Chinese government. So, let us see. We will get more clarity within end of November.

items.statement: Traditional generation (Mumbai + Hydro) EBITDA up 37% YoY to INR 3.51 bn in Q2 due to efficiency and DSM gains; DSM not material but better summer gains
items.quote: It is a combination of efficiency and DSM both together. Of cour se, our idea is to sustain that. We will have to find means of improving on our efficiencies as we move forward

items.statement: Rooftop solar growing fast in UP, Odisha, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and now Delhi; subsidy continues till March, new avatar expected beyond March
items.quote: The rooftop business is going very fast everywhere. In fact, it is going very fast in U.P. and Odisha, as also in Maharashtra and Rajasthan, and now it will happen in Delhi.

items.statement: Management expects market to hold for next couple of quarters and aims to convert demand strongly
items.quote: While we do not make the forward-looking statement, we feel that the market is going to hold at least for the next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Industry volume expected to cross 500,000 units this year, a record high
items.quote: We are confident that overall the market would pan for this year +500, which is again a record because the previous highest was in 2018, 480,000, which we already did last year.

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin at 13.7%, up 10 bps QoQ and 160 bps YoY for H1
items.quote: Overall, our metal costs for the quarter stood at 66.2%. All our other overheads are slightly lower in terms of percentages thanks to the higher top line of 28%. We did get a lot of absorption benefits. So, that leaves us with EBITDA of close to about INR910 million at 13.7%.

items.statement: Phase 1 capacity expansion of 20-30% to be completed by next quarter; Phase 2 strategy under evaluation for INR5,000 crore revenue target by 2030
items.quote: We started investing in our capacity to enhance it by at least 20%-30%, which we are getting realized now. Not completely, but we will be completing it by next quarter.

items.statement: Current capacity sufficient for 500,000 unit MHCV market; tandem axle ramp-up by Q4 FY27
items.quote: Your understanding is correct. This capacity, what we are there, we should be able to manage these peaks.

items.statement: Heavy-duty tractor and tipper volumes predominant; air suspension models growing
items.quote: Generally, Kishan mentioned that you know there is a big demand in the heavy-duty segment, so there are a lot of tractors and tipper volumes coming, along with some air suspension models.

items.statement: Largest customer shifting to air suspension but company's axles already proven and protected for that transition
items.quote: The required customization for that type of a suspension is already done. So we are well protected. That changeover, shift over will not impact us in terms of our share of business.

items.statement: Metal cost at 66.2% of revenue; commodity increases passed back-to-back with customers and suppliers
items.quote: Overall, our metal costs for the quarter stood at 66.2%. All our other overheads are slightly lower in terms of percentages thanks to the higher top line of 28%.

items.statement: Supply chain constraints on steel and gear lead times of 6-8 weeks; developing alternate suppliers
items.quote: Some of the materials, like gears, they may have anywhere between kind of six to eight weeks of lead time from getting the steel all the way to finishing those parts.

items.statement: Export volumes consistent with last year; focus on domestic market; exploring additional export opportunities after capacity addition
items.quote: Our export has remained consistent in the same levels as what we had last year. And the main focus is, as Kishan as well as mentioned, is the domestic market, where there is a lot of traction happening, so we are servicing that.

items.statement: Prudent material planning to manage volatile forecasts; agreements to avoid inventorying slow-moving materials
items.quote: We have been very prudent in terms of planning our material. So, again, obsolescence is always a challenge, but we also have a very good understanding and agreement with the customer, where we do not inventorize slow-moving or non-moving material.

items.statement: Advance tax paid at 45% of estimated annual liability (INR31 crore net of refund) for H1
items.quote: It is as per our estimated profits for the year. As per the statutory limits, we have paid 45% of what was supposed to be paid.

items.statement: Four to five new products launched since 2020 addressing market shift to higher tonnage and EV architectures
items.quote: 2020 onwards, there are four to five new products which were not there earlier because the market has also shifted. There are other factors that influence these changes. All these four, five, we are ahead. The competition is now catching up.

items.statement: Headwinds from commodity price increases and supply chain constraints; market sustainability beyond April uncertain
items.quote: Having said that, I already mentioned that there are quite a bit of headwinds are there, both in terms of the price increase and the supply chain constraints.

items.statement: Expect upward trajectory to continue in upcoming quarters; no exact numerical guidance given
items.quote: we remain poised to sustain this trajectory in the upcoming quarters.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA INR1,760 crores (highest-ever) vs INR1,512 crores YoY; PAT INR1,573 crores up 15%
items.quote: Our EBITDA is an highest-ever EBITDA of INR1,760 crores versus INR1,512 crores in Q2 last year.

items.statement: Four price hikes CYTD; latest 0.7% in October; calibrated approach based on commodity and perceived value
items.quote: In October also, we have taken an increase of about 0.7%.

items.statement: All models growing; Himalayan 440 propelled growth of Himalayan 450; adventure segment booking strong
items.quote: Himalayan 440 actually propelled the growth of even Himalayan 450.

items.quote: the Flying Flea C6 was also introduced in Paris, Barcelona, Rome, and Berlin, and London in September, a significant milestone for us.

items.quote: Post Diwali, our channel stock is, we are acting, is almost about seven to eight days, including the transit.

items.quote: During the quarter, we registered our highest-ever quarter sales at 376,722 motorcycles, as against 327,067 in Q2 FY26, registering a growth of 15%.

items.statement: VECV Q2 sales 28,071 vehicles, up 28.2% YoY; H1 52,886 up 21.5%; revenue INR7,568.6 crores up 24%; EBITDA INR587.7 crores up 22.7%; PAT INR341.6 crores up 37%
items.quote: VECV achieved its best-ever Q2 sales with 28,071 vehicles sold, an increase of 28.2% over the same quarter last year.

items.quote: We are preponing that, and we will get it by Q4 of FY27, which will take the capacity to 1.8 million per year, which will be readily available for Q1 of FY28.

items.quote: In the ready-to-drink category, we launched Kultur, our hard seltzer in Madhya Pradesh in June with registration underway in 4 states.

items.quote: Our long-term aim for IMFL margin remains in the range of 15% to 17%.

items.quote: So a combination of the entire thing would obviously bring back, the margin of IMFL EBITDA margin, which is there at 10% right now, back to around early teens or around 13% to 14%.

items.quote: See, as Tushar-ji already said, raw material prices is already elevated and still it is elevating and it is increasing. It is very significant. It is all time high. So in near terms, we do not feel that it will achieve 45%.

items.quote: Coming to IMFL Proprietary, revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR577 million, up 39% year-on-year basis. It contributes around 30% of Alcobev revenue. The EBITDA margin for the business stood at 10%.

items.quote: In the ethanol segment, Q2 FY27 revenue stood at INR763 million with an EBITDA margin of 1%.

items.quote: So, we have spent around INR2 crores to INR2.5 crores on branding and advertising, and there is in this quarter around INR2 crores to INR2.5 crores which has been impacted because of the raw material price hike.
