items.quote: So what do we commit to you for the full year? I will say it as clearly as I did before. More than 1,25,000 units, more than 550 dealers, new high-speed models, and revenue growth of 75% to 80%.

items.statement: Target to achieve 25% market share within next 2 years
items.quote: It's around now I think 8% to 9%, and our target is to achieve 25% market share within the next 2 years.

items.statement: Target to sell more than 1 million scooters annually by 2030 with at least 25% market share
items.quote: Up to 2030 -- up to 2030 our target is, sir, by 2030 our targets are that we will sell more than 1 million scooters every year and our market share should be at least 25%.

items.statement: Patan plant investment over INR20 crores, partly funded by IPO proceeds and internal accruals
items.quote: The investment is more than INR20 crores, and a large part of it is backward integration, so that more of what goes into Zelio is made by Zelio. It is funded partly from our IPO proceeds as per the objects of the issue and the rest from our own accruals.

items.statement: Preferential issue of INR168 crores approved for R&D, backward integration and future capacity expansion
items.quote: Mainly, our objective is to spend on R&D and backward integration. We will invest more in R&D and also in backward integration. Also, we will increase our capacities, prepare ourselves for the future, and set up capacities and lines.

items.statement: Four plants with total installed capacity of 3.12 lakh units; Patan adds 72,000 units annually
items.quote: Today, we have four plants, Ladwa, Cuttack, Coimbatore, and Patan, that is North East & South, with 3.12 lakh units of installed capacity closer to our customers, faster to our dealers, lower on logistics cost.

items.statement: Patan plant capacity utilization target of 80% within next 2 years
items.quote: We will utilize the Patan plant up to almost 80% within the next 2 years.

items.statement: Current utilization: Hisar 70-80%, Odisha ~50%, Coimbatore ~30%, overall 40-50%
items.quote: Right now, our utilization is almost 40%-50%. And secondly, we have raised funds so that we can invest in R&D, so that we can invest in power training, in batteries, in motors, so that we can build something of our own.

items.statement: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR296.66 crores, more than double YoY; standalone revenue INR289.10 crores
items.quote: Now, this half year, our consolidated revenue from operations for the 6 months was INR296.66 crores, more than double the same period last year.

items.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR40.49 crores, margin 13.6% vs 12% YoY; PAT INR31.39 crores, net margin above 10%
items.quote: EBITDA was INR40.49 crores and our EBITDA margin went up from 12% last year to 13.6%. Profit after tax was INR31.39 crores, more than 2.5 times last year's first half with a net margin above 10%.

items.statement: R&D investment may impact EBITDA by 1-2%
items.quote: And if we talk about economic scale, our numbers are improving, our EBITDA will not reduce. But when we invest in R&D, it will have an effect of 1%-2%. Because we will invest a huge amount of money on R&D.

items.statement: Average SKU price increased from INR45,000 to INR48,000-50,000 due to raw material and metal price increases
items.quote: Our average SKU price was earlier almost INR45,000, but due to increases in raw material and metal prices, it has now become almost INR48,000 to INR50,000 on average.

items.statement: Price increases did not impact demand as EV demand rose with fuel price hikes
items.quote: Sir, in the market, there was an increase in metal prices 3-4 months ago, which increased our ASP. But the demand in the market also increased because of the rise of fuel prices, like EV demand. So it didn't impact us. In fact, our demands increased.

items.statement: Import content varies by SKU: some 70%, some 30%, some 100%; Tanga 20-30% imported (electrical parts); two-wheelers: 4 SKUs 70% in-house, 4-8 SKUs 40% in-house, 7-8 SKUs 100% imported
items.quote: Sir, we have 16 to 17 SKUs. In like if you talk about Tanga, inside Tanga our import percentage is around 30%, 20% to 30%. Only electrical parts are imported. Other parts are third-party sourced and after the Patan plant is ready we will make them ourselves. And if we talk about two-wheelers, inside two-wheelers we have four SKUs which are 70% inhouse, meaning we have Indianized products and 30% i

items.statement: H1 FY27 volumes: 62,000+ two-wheelers (mostly low-speed), ~600 three-wheelers; FY26 full year: 70,000+ two-wheelers, 650 three-wheelers
items.quote: Taher ji, last year in two-wheelers alone, in complete FY26, we sold more than 70,000 units. And in this half year only, we have sold 62,000-plus units of two-wheelers. And in high speed, if you can compare, our company's maximum sales are of low-speed scooters. The proportion of high speed is currently less.

items.statement: Plan to launch 2-3 high-speed models in next 2 years at prices much lower than competitors
items.quote: In the next 2 years, sir, we are launching almost two to three high-speed vehicles. And secondly, talking about revenue, sir, the government gets revenue from imports and in high speed they don't get any separate revenue, because most of the state governments have made registration free on high speed.

items.statement: B2C focus for brand visibility and margins; B2B deferred until extra capacity available
items.quote: Sir, actually, right now we are in the B2B segment, and now we are in the B2C segment through dealers. And in our B2C segment, we have demands. And the problem in the B2B segment is that the profits there are less, and the brand doesn't get visibility. And we are getting very good demands from the B2C segment right now.

items.statement: MoRTH draft notification proposes increasing low-speed motor limit from 250W to 600W; government positive on segment, stricter rules to benefit organized players
items.quote: No, sir, there is no such chance because as you might seen that in MoRTH issued a draft notification 3 months ago which has not come into act, but before for low-speed vehicles from 250 watt, but now they have proposed that they are increasing up to 600 watt motorThe government is entirely positive toward this segment.

items.statement: H1 operating cash flow negative due to inventory build-up and supplier advances for festive season; borrowings rose to INR44.82 crores, debt-to-equity 0.31x from 0.18x; receivables <6 days
items.quote: During the half, we built inventory and paid advances to our suppliers to secure supplies before the festive season and to feed our new plants. Because of that, our operating cash flow for the half was negative and our borrowings went up to INR44.82 crores. Our debt-to-equity is now 0.31 times against 0.18 times in March.

items.statement: Expect working capital to ease in H2 as inventory converts to sales; MD reviews weekly
items.quote: As it turns into sales in the second half, we expect working capital to ease. I personally review it every week, and I will report it to you on the next call.

items.statement: Preferential issue of INR168 crores approved with promoter participation via warrants; monitoring agency confirms no deviation in IPO proceeds usage
items.quote: And last month, our shareholders approved our preferential issue of about INR168 crores, for a company that came to the SME platform just over a year ago. This is a big step. It means reputed institutional investors have studied our business closely and chosen to partner with us for the long term. A meaningful part of it is the promoter's own money through warrants.

items.statement: Promoter invested own money through warrants in preferential issue
items.quote: A meaningful part of it is the promoter's own money through warrants. When we ask you to believe in Zelio, we are putting our own money behind the same belief.

items.statement: Preferential issue of INR168 crores approved by shareholders
items.quote: And last month, our shareholders approved our preferential issue of about INR168 crores, for a company that came to the SME platform just over a year ago.

items.statement: Monitoring agency report for September quarter shows no deviation in IPO proceeds usage
items.quote: Our monitoring agency report for September quarter filed two days ago shows no deviation in how we have used the IPO proceeds. Every rupee has gone where we told you it would.

items.statement: Customs show-cause notice of INR6.72 crores received; company appealing, matter industry-wide, not paid under protest
items.quote: We have not paid, sir. We are fighting for it. We have appealed in customs, that is our matter is that it is not justified, it is baseless. We have filed and it is not just us, it has come to the entire industry. It is not alone on me, whatever has been imported, it is on all of us and everyone has filed a complaint regarding that and it will most probably come in our favor.

items.statement: Net worth grew from INR111.5 crores to INR142.9 crores in H1
items.quote: Our net worth has grown from INR111.5 crores in March to INR142.9 crores.

items.statement: Low-speed EV market estimated >50% of total electric two-wheeler volumes; low-speed considered backbone of Indian EV market
items.quote: More than 50%. And because right now we don't have numbers. Until now only high-speed numbers are visible in the market, low-speed numbers are not known.

items.statement: R&D investment of INR168 crore proceeds may reduce EBITDA by 1-2%
items.quote: But when we invest in R&D, it will have an effect of 1%-2%. Because we will invest a huge amount of money on R&D.

items.statement: Plan to list on main board within 1-2 years
items.quote: Maybe in a year, maybe in 2 years. But, maybe in the next 2 years, probably we will come to the main board. And who knows, we might even come to the main board.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR2,050 crores and PAT of INR540-550 crores
items.value: INR2,050 crores revenue; INR540-550 crores PAT
items.quote: So what we are expecting is close to INR2,050 crores in the current year and the PAT margin, PAT will remain, you can say, close to, INR540 crores to INR550 crores.

items.statement: FY28 revenue guidance of INR2,550 crores with 20% from new hospitals and 10-12% EBITDA contribution
items.quote: Here, we're talking about for the next year, we are expecting a top line of -- I'm talking about FY28, we are expecting a top line of close to INR2,550 crores, wherein we are expecting 20% of the number will come from these hospitals

items.statement: INR750 crores capex for 2,300 beds by December 2028 at INR33.5-35 lakhs per bed
items.quote: As far as our expansion plan is concerned, December 2028, we are -- these other projects, those are under execution as of now, the total capex that we plan is INR750 crores and that will add 2,300 beds.

items.statement: Bed capacity to grow 54% to 6,590 beds by December 2028 from 4,290 beds currently
items.quote: The company currently has 2,300 beds under execution, which are expected to become operational by December '28, taking the total bed capacity to 6,590 beds from 4,290 beds as on 30 September 2026.

items.statement: FY27 bed capacity expansion of 40% (1,430 beds) with 680 beds already added
items.quote: We remain on track to expand our bed capacity by 40% in FY27 over FY26. So far this year, we have added 680 beds across Panchkula and Rudrapur, and we expect to add further 750 beds across our facilities over the rest of the year.

items.statement: Established 14 hospitals delivered 26% EBITDA and 17% PAT margins in H1 FY27
items.quote: excluding our newly opened hospitals in Agra, Panchkula and Rudrapur, our 14 established hospitals delivered an EBITDA margin of 26% and PAT margin of 17% in H1 FY27

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin 23% in H1 FY27 due to 8% EBITDA loss from 3 new hospitals
items.quote: The 14 units delivered a revenue of INR915 crores, three new units, I'm talking about Rudrapur, Agra and Panchkula, they delivered a revenue of INR72 crores. The revenue came at INR987 crores. EBITDA for these 14 units is INR234 crores. But we have taken a hit of INR6 crores in EBITDA for these three units. That's the reason from INR234 crores, EBITDA came down to INR228 crores in H1 FY27.

items.statement: H1 FY27 served record 5.39 lakh patients with IPD and OPD volumes each growing 23% YoY
items.quote: During the first half of financial year '27, we served a record 5.39 lakh patients and delivered our highest ever half yearly revenue from operations of INR987 crores, a year-on-year increase of 22%.

items.statement: ARPOB rose 13% YoY to INR30,548 and ALOS improved 11% to 5.6 days in H1 FY27
items.quote: For H1 2027, IPD and OPD volumes each grew 23% year-on-year to 57,000 and 482,000 patients, respectively. ARPOB rose 13% to 30,548 and ALOS improved 11% to 5.6 days from 6.4 days in H1 financial year 2026.

items.statement: High-end specialties contributed 63% of H1 FY27 revenue, up 640 bps YoY
items.quote: Our case mix continues to shift towards high-end tertiary and quaternary care. High-end specialties contributed approximately 64% of the revenue in Q2 financial year 2027, up by 730 basis points year-on-year and approximately 63% in H1 FY 2027, up by 640 basis points.

items.statement: Government insurance schemes contribute 76% of revenue, targeting 70/30 split over 12-18 months
items.quote: Government insurance schemes contribute approximately 76% of our revenue in the quarter, with self-pay and private insurance or TPA contributing 24% continuing the gradual step towards the 70/30 split we guided to over the next 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Cancer drug price capping has negligible impact; CGHS rate hike to add INR58-60 crores in FY27
items.quote: I'm happy to announce today that the implication for Park is negligible. It is not that significant, it is negligible. We can safely say it has no implication for Park.

items.statement: Receivable days at 160 as of September 2026, expected to reduce to 125-130 days by March 2027
items.quote: Currently, we are at 160 days and what we have done because the addition that we have done in this calendar year, there are 2 acquisitions that we have made. One is Agra, and Rudrapur. And they have the outstanding basis, which is close to INR45 crores.

items.statement: October 2026 collections reduced receivable days by 30-35 days to 135-136 days
items.quote: If someone can see my outstanding as of 31st October 2026, we are at 135, 136 days. So at a consol level, we talk about yearly basis annualized, if I talk about we will remain in 125, 130 days, which is where if we talk about as of 31 March 2027.

items.statement: Term debt of INR178 crores and fixed deposits of INR325 crores as of September 2026
items.value: INR178 crores term debt; INR325 crores fixed deposits
items.quote: As of 30 September 2026, our term debt, excluding lease liabilities, stood at INR178 crores, while fixed deposits stood at INR325 crores.

items.statement: Will acquire remaining 20% stake in V3 Healthcare (Rudrapur) by end of FY27 or Q1 FY28
items.period: by end of FY27 or Q1 FY28
items.quote: And for this 80%, yes, we have taken 80% now with clear cut understanding and a commitment that 20% will be bought within a specific period of time. But we plan to buy, I think, by close of this financial year or maximum in the first quarter of next year.

items.statement: F&B costs increased 50% (INR270 to INR400 per meal) adding INR7.5 crores in H1; medicine costs up due to high-end mix shift
items.quote: What has happened is that we have had some of our consumable and medicine cost increase in this quarter. The reason is that in our preparation for the future, a lot of expenses have seen a onetime increase, which we believe will be aligned with revenues in the forthcoming 2 quarters.

items.statement: Network occupancy at 56% in Q2 and H1 FY27 vs 68% YoY due to new capacity additions
items.quote: Network occupancy was 56% for both Q2 and H1 FY27 as compared to 68% in the corresponding period of financial year 2026. This was largely due to the step-up in capacity over the past 12 months.

items.statement: Doctor count increased by 232 to 1,400 from 1,168 between March and September 2027
items.quote: Also the number of doctors increased by 232 from 1168 in March 2027 to 1,400 by September 2027.

items.statement: Claims disallowed rate at 13.5% vs 11% YoY, expected to normalize by year-end
items.quote: So claims disallowed that we -- again, there are some seasonality in this and currently, we are at 13.5% as compared to 11% in the same period last year. But if you see again by the end of the current financial year, we will come down to that level.

items.statement: Capex per bed remains at INR35-36 lakhs for 2,300 beds under execution; Allahabad PPP at INR25 lakhs/bed after government reimbursement
items.quote: Our capex per bed remain at INR35 lakhs, INR36 lakhs even what we plan to add another 2,300 beds by December 2028, those are under execution. And for these 2,300 beds, we need about INR750 crores. So currently, we have a capex for that which is about INR35, INR36 lakhs.

items.statement: Rudrapur hospital (80% stake) at INR5 crores monthly run-rate, targeting INR7.5 crores by December and INR10+ crores by April 2027
items.quote: What we have done as far as operational performance is concerned, we started from 1st August and we are already EBITDA positive. So currently, we have a run rate which is close to INR5 crores per month. And for December, we are expecting that will touch INR7.5 crores. And for April, 2027 that we are expecting it will grow more than INR10 crores per month.

items.statement: New hospitals EBITDA drag of INR6 crores in H1 FY27; expected to break even by end of FY27
items.quote: We have an EBITDA loss of 8% in these three units, but it will streamline by end of the current year. And if you see without these, so our existing 14 hospitals, we have delivered EBITDA of 26%. And if you remove this figure of 8%, the blended EBITDA came down to 23%.

items.statement: Brownfield hospitals breakeven in 4-6 months, greenfield in 12-15 months; 70% occupancy by year 3 (brownfield) or year 4 (greenfield)
items.quote: Historically, what we have seen that brownfield, the acquired asset normally give us -- we achieve operating breakeven within 4 to 5 months or 4 to 6 months. But for greenfield, it takes about 12 to 15 months' time.

items.statement: Net worth increased from INR1,196 crores in H1 FY26 to INR2,164 crores in H1 FY27
items.quote: The net worth of the company has also increased from INR1,196 crores in H1 FY26 to INR2,164 crores in H1 FY27.

items.statement: Revenue target of INR 1,000 crores in next 2-3 years
items.quote: The commitment of INR1,000 crores we have made and the INR1,000 crores we have to achieve -- we are striking at that run rate.

items.statement: 3PL model to start by April 2027
items.quote: we are also implementing our new revenue model which we call 3PL, and we are hoping that we will start by April 2027.

items.statement: Sustained demand across e-commerce, quick commerce, logistics, warehousing and workforce intensive industries
items.quote: sustained demand across e-commerce, quick commerce, logistics, warehousing and other workforce intensive industries.

items.statement: Quick commerce is a very fast-growing segment and core focus area
items.quote: In this time, quick commerce is a very fast-growing segment. So, our core focus is on that.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 62 bps to 4.01% in H1 FY27 including other income; excluding other income EBITDA grew 12.23%
items.quote: EBITDA increased by 81.64% to INR6.70 crores compared with INR3.69 crores in H1 FY26. And our EBITDA margin improved by 62 basis points to 4.01%.

items.statement: 3PL model expected to increase EBITDA and revenue, reduce dependence on other income
items.quote: we are going to the 3PL model that will really help us to increase our EBITDA as well as revenue and we will not be the part of other like we will not be dependent to the other income

items.quote: as on 30th September 2026 we have deployed over 15,000 personnel through a broad network spanning 25 states.

items.quote: Of INR9.75 crores allocated from our IPO proceed for working capital, INR2.85 crores has been utilized by 30th September 2026 and the balance will support payroll funding for larger clients.

items.quote: our the major client you can say the Flipkart, Myntra, Shadowfax and JWL, Jindal. Rajeev sir: Jindal Group and Euler Motors

items.quote: Normally, we renew the contract for 1 year. And -- but -- yes, and every year we just renew it. So the average duration if we talk about that is 1 year.

items.quote: it is the other current asset 23 that is our unbilled revenue which we build in October that was the unbilled revenue for September which we build in October.

items.quote: Frankly, the cash flow will not much change by end of this financial year. But if we talk about the next year, 6 months cash flow, that will be completely different because then our 3PL model will be implemented

items.quote: Our business remain asset light and debt light, with shareholder fund of INR43.72 crores as of 30th September 2026.

items.statement: INR 4.06 crores short-term loans and advances to sub-vendors in H1 FY27
items.quote: That is our sub-vendors actually, we paid them in advance and then they bill us later.

items.statement: Revenue run rate approximately INR 180 crores half-yearly as of H1 FY27
items.quote: Right now, you will see we are sitting at approximately INR180 plus on a half-yearly basis.

items.statement: 100% of 15,000 deployed personnel on company payroll
items.quote: Yes, all our company's payroll and we are doing their compliance on the PF and ESI as well.

items.statement: Focus on scaling higher margin services: payroll outsourcing, compliance audits, HR consulting
items.quote: scaling higher margin services such as payroll outsourcing, compliance audits and HR consulting to improve profitability.

items.statement: Other income includes INR 1.67 crores from Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Yojana employment scheme reimbursement
items.quote: This includes other income of INR2.67 crores of which INR1.67 crores related to employment scheme reimbursement.

items.statement: High attrition rate in business model; festive season workers hired on short-term contracts
items.quote: because the attrition rate is very high in this model so people walk and just go.

items.quote: if we talk about the major revenue then we can say that Flipkart, Myntra and Shadowfax, yes and JWL, they are major clients.

items.quote: In September 2026 we have received Best Supporters Vendor Award from Shadowfax which reflects the service commitment our team brings every day.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to stabilize at 12.5%-13% for H2 FY27
items.quote: Looking ahead, we expect EBITDA margin to stabilize in the range of 12.5% to 13%.

items.quote: We are also targeting improvement of approximately 25 to 40 days in working capital days by Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Expect operating cash flow to turn positive for FY27
items.quote: Accordingly, we expect operating cash flow to turn positive for FY27.

items.quote: As of September 30th, 2026, our order book stood at approximately INR2,543 crores, comprising approximately INR1,303 crores from manufacturing, INR1,240 crores from EPC.

items.statement: New orders of INR357 crores secured in Q2 FY27; H1 FY27 inflow at INR449 crores
items.quote: During Q2 of FY27, we secured new orders of approximately INR357 crores, and taking our inflow of H1 financial year FY27 to approximately INR449 crores.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 12.1% vs 13% YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 12.3%
items.quote: EBITDA was INR76 crores with an EBITDA margin of around 12.1% compared to 13% in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Manufacturing segment EBITDA margin typically 10-11%; EPC segment EBITDA margin typically 14-16%
items.quote: Manufacturing segment typically remain between 10% to 11% and 11% roughly and hence the mix land up to 13%.

items.statement: Heavy rains caused EPC execution delays and INR100 cr revenue deferral in H1 FY27
items.quote: So, at least, my revenue were deferred for roughly INR100 crores, INR100 crores EPC revenue which were deferred because of these delays.

items.statement: Received provisional LOI and in-principle approval for ~40 acres at Vidyasagar Industrial Park, Kharagpur for integrated cable and conductor facility
items.quote: During the quarter, we have received provisional letter of intent and in-principle approval from West Bengal Industrial Development Corporation Limited for allotment of approximately 40 acres of land at Vidyasagar Industrial Park in Kharagpur on long-term lease.

items.statement: Kharagpur capex timing and scale to be aligned with demand visibility, utilization, product mix and returns; details next quarter
items.quote: Once we do our entire planning about the capex and financial arrangements, we will discuss about it probably the next quarter.

items.statement: Manufacturing utilization maintained at roughly 70-75%; full year FY27 utilization expected at ~70%
items.quote: So, on full year basis, we can see the utilization of production would be roughly at 70%, and that's the way we will keep it.

items.statement: Manufacturing revenue mix expected to remain 80-90% cables, 10-15% conductors; shift within conductors from conventional to specialized (HTLS)
items.quote: So, our mix will be dominated by 90% cable. It should remain 90 -- the cable should remain between 80% to 90% and conductor will remain between 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Current manufacturing order book split ~85% cables, ~15% conductors
items.quote: It would be roughly like 85% would be cable and 15% conductors. That's how the current order book reflects for manufacturing.

items.statement: First commercial HTLS conductor order of INR72.76 crores from Power Grid; first 220 kV underground EPC order of INR44 crores from CESC
items.quote: The most significant development of the period was the award of a contract aggregating to INR72.76 crores from power grid for supply of high temperature low sag or HTLS conductors and reconductoring of the existing transmission lines.

items.statement: EPC revenue mix 50-50% government/private on manufacturing side; EPC projects majorly for government utilities
items.quote: Our typical revenue mix is 50-50% on manufacturing side between government and private sector. And order book also reflects the same. But EPC is the last customer, is always government.

items.statement: TS Conductors technology is newer generation with cost advantages over earlier ACCC technology; expect utilities to adopt as advantages recognized
items.quote: The newer generation technology and comparing it with the earlier one, as we go forward there are also cost advantages attached to the new technology. So, even if competition is there, the new technology is giving us an advantage, an edge over the earlier technology as far as cost is concerned.

items.statement: Working capital at INR1,159 crores (166 days) as of Sep 30, 2026 vs INR1,059 crores (183 days) end Q1; inventory rose to INR946 cr from INR710 cr
items.quote: As on September 30th, 2026, working capital stood approximately at INR1,159 crores compared with approximately INR1,059 crores at the end of Q1.

items.statement: Trade receivables reduced to INR1,382 crores from INR1,416 crores end Q1; working capital peaked in September and now normalizing
items.quote: Trade receivable, however, reduced to INR1,382 crores from INR1,416 crores at the end of quarter 1.

items.statement: Repaid ~INR490 crores borrowings from IPO proceeds in Q2; total borrowing ~INR499 crores as of Sep 30, 2026
items.quote: During Q2, we utilized approximately INR490 crores from our IPO proceeds towards repayment of identified borrowings. As on September 30th, the total borrowing stood at approximately INR499 crores.

items.statement: Crude volatility impacted H1 margins; 70 crore revenue target achievable even if crude falls further
items.quote: Crude bahut volatile hua hai is time. Yeh do ya teen din neeche hota hai, phir koi news aati hai, phir upar ho jaata hai. Toh abhi crude ke prices kuch keh nahi sakte. Agar crude neeche bhi chala gaya, tab bhi hum 70 tak achievable hain.

items.statement: H1 FY27 PAT margin 8.5% vs 6.9% YoY; EBITDA margin expected to improve 100-200 bps from FY28 due to Asoda efficiencies
items.quote: Toh wahan pe hamari efficiency aayegi toh maybe 100 basis points or 200 basis points mera EBITDA margin hoga improve, but that would be reflected in FY 27-28 onwards, not in this current six months.

items.statement: H1 margin dent due to crude volatility and seasonal lean period; full year expected to recover
items.quote: Uski wajah se jo profit mein thoda sa dent aaya woh aapko mila, lekin we are able to shift our expenses and we didn't incur any that much of loss. Aur usme hum log very hopeful hain iske andar ki yeh cheez hum cover kar jaayenge. Jo hamare numbers hain na, full year mein aapko comparative dikh jaayega.

items.statement: Working capital needs may rise with capacity expansion; 70-75 days credit cycle; may use working capital limits
items.quote: Generally 70-75 days ka agar credit hai, toh you can understand ki kahin na kahin mujhe apna margin ke liye agar main market mein advance paisa phenkta hoon na, toh mujhe maal sasta mil jaata hai. Toh uske liye working capital ki requirement ho sakti hai, but abhi nahi dekh rahe usko.

items.statement: Term loan free; borrowings only Rs 0.6 crore; may take working capital limits but no term debt planned
items.quote: In terms of term loan, yes, we wish to be debt-free. We might have some working capital limits for, provision ek leke chalenge ki working capital limit jaise ki ab aapko bataya maine ki hamari capacity jab itni increase ho jaayegi, toh humein market mein samaan dena padega.

items.quote: 14 Cr aaya hamare paas isme se, ab total 18 Cr ki agar baat karoon main, out of that 18 somewhere 2.4 or 2.5 has gone to issue expenses. items.statement: Promoter holding ~45% post-IPO (was 62-63% pre-IPO); friends & family hold ~50% and not selling; considering increasing promoter stake
items.quote: Friends and families are which are there which are not going to leave, which are not going to go anywhere in near future. It is there, it is much more than that, it is 50%. But then again everyone has those apprehensions for being in a promoter category na.

items.statement: IPO on BSE SME in September 2026; proceeds used for Croda investment, debt repayment, working capital
items.quote: In September 2026, we listed on the BSE SME platform.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty on titanium dioxide in pigment segment under review, possible removal
items.quote: Woh pigment wale section mein titanium pe lagi hai anti-dumping duty. Mujhe lag raha hai ki shayad woh wapsi na ho jaaye, kyunki yeh review kar rahe hain dobara.

items.statement: No immediate export plans; exports planned for near future
items.quote: Aur baaki exports ka abhi immediate nahi hai, lekin haan near future mein woh bhi plan kiya hua hai humne exports ka bhi.

items.statement: No major headwinds seen; industry in troubled waters but crude cooling and orders in hand provide comfort
items.quote: Basically, as such koi headwind, we are already into troubled waters. What's your name? Sharan? Sandeep Pandey: Yes sir.Sharan: Whom am I addressing? items.statement: Pigment subsidiary targeting 50% growth to Rs 14-15 crore in FY27 from Rs 10+ crore in FY26
items.quote: And as we say all in all year basis, we will be doing approximately 14 to 15 Cr in our subsidiary and rest in our parent company Amtech. So earlier in the subsidiary last year it was 10 point something Cr, and we are projecting a growth of approximately 50% growth in our subsidiary.

items.statement: Pre-sales guidance for FY27 is 20% growth to Rs 2,500-3,000 crore
items.quote: So our guidance still remains for the whole year basis. We should be growing our pre-sales close to 20%, as indicated last time. So we are looking at a number very in a close vicinity of 2,500- 2,600 to 3,000 Crores, somewhere between that, representing a growth of around 20% in comparison to what we have shown previous year.

items.statement: Revenue recognition expected to be roughly 10% higher than FY26 with margins reverting to FY26 levels
items.quote: So we should be, in terms of revenue recognition, we should be looking at a number again, which is roughly 10% higher than what has happened in FY26, and in terms of the margins, we should revert back to the margins that were shown or that we achieved in FY26.

items.statement: FY28 pre-sales guidance implied at 20-25% growth over FY27
items.quote: So, with a figure that you can estimate for FY27, adding another 20% on top of that should be the guidance. I mean, I will leave you with this particular statement.

items.statement: Net debt-to-equity reduced from 3.1x to 1.5x at end of Q2 FY27
items.quote: It is my pleasure to inform that we have reduced our net debt-to-equity ratio from 3.1x to 1.5 at the end of this quarter, as indicated by us on the previous call.

items.statement: Rs 221 crore of net debt attributable to annuity assets (mall and commercial) as of September 2026
items.quote: So put together in the entire net debt, around Rs. 221 crores is on account of annuity asset as of now. And the balance is on account of residential projects.

items.statement: Land monetization in MyCity Dombivli underway with 11-12 interested parties via JLL mandate
items.quote: We are looking at monetizing a small acreage of land parcel in MyCity project. We have also appointed JLL to run this mandate for us, and we have got interest from around 11- 12 parties. We are evaluating those and we will be very soon letting you know the outcome of that.

items.statement: Pre-sales grew 26% QoQ to Rs 609 crore in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Our pre-sales increased from Rs. 484 crores in Q1 to Rs. 609 crores in Q2, thereby representing a decent and healthy growth of around 26%.

items.statement: Gross collections grew 23.5% YoY to Rs 550 crore in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Gross collections increased from Rs. 445 crores from Q2 in FY26 to Rs. 550 crores in Q2 of FY27, thereby representing a growth of 23.5%.

items.statement: Ready-to-move-in inventory of 0.38 msf (70% in MyCity Cluster 5) targeted for full liquidation by end of FY27
items.quote: So as of now, if I talk about the ready-to-move-in inventory, we have close to 0.38 million square feet of completed saleable area inventory. Around 70% of it is primarily in our project Runwal MyCity, Cluster 5, where we have now got OC as well. So we are selling the ready-to-move-in inventory over there as well. And we are expecting to sell almost all of these inventories by end of FY27.

items.quote: Average selling price, as indicated by Pradumnaji, also has shown an increase from Rs. 12,600 per square feet of saleable area in last quarter of FY26 to Rs. 14,907 per square feet of sellable area in Q2 of FY27. This represents an increase of around 12%.

items.statement: ASP driven by 7 Mahalaxmi project and retail/commercial strata sales; expected to remain in similar range normalized
items.quote: So, going ahead, I mean, we are expecting our average selling price to remain by and large in a similar range, primarily because of the contribution of 7 Mahalaxmi has also kind of stabilized. items.statement: Targeting 33% contribution each from affordable, mid-income and luxury segments going forward
items.quote: But going forward, once all launches are stabilized, we would expect 33% contribution from each one of these three segments. And as that happens, we see that our price points continue to improve.

items.statement: Delivered 1.90 msf in H1 FY27 vs 0.86 msf in H1 FY26, more than doubling execution
items.quote: Area delivered more than doubled from 0.86 million square feet in the first half of FY26 to 1.90 million square feet in the first half of FY27.

items.statement: Ongoing commercial projects of 300,000 sq ft and retail mall of 800,000 sq ft across Runwal BKC and Dombivli
items.quote: We currently have approximately 300,000 square feet of ongoing commercial projects and around 800,000 square feet on the retail mall side. These are spread across Runwal BKC and the retail mall at Dombivli.

items.quote: Mahalaxmi also two towers are up and running the sales and collection, construction, everything continues there. There may be a launch of a new tower, which is tower three, and probably we'll get to hear the news about that launch in the fourth quarter of this fiscal year.

items.statement: No projects awaiting regulatory approval for launch; no running projects waiting for approvals
items.quote: No, so we don't have any project that is waiting approval primarily for the purpose of launch. Launches and everything remains as per our timeline. items.quote: As of September, we had approximately 88.37 million square feet of development area spread across important micro-markets within MMR, including 18.14 million square feet on ongoing projects and roughly around 56 million square feet for upcoming projects.

items.statement: Annual cash flows in excess of Rs 2,000 crore last year; expecting 20-30% growth this year
items.quote: These numbers are also very sustainable, given the fact that our annual cash flows are in excess of Rs. 2000 crores last year or thereabouts. And this year also, we are expecting a 20%-30% growth on that.

items.statement: Mumbai inventory overhang largely under-construction; ready-to-move-in proportion significantly lower and market expected to absorb comfortably
items.quote: It has been seen with respect to two things. items.statement: Revenue growth expected around 20% for CY26
items.quote: For CY26, we expect our revenue growth to be around 20%.

items.statement: Revenue CAGR of 15% targeted over CY26-28 with EBITDA margin near 18.5%
items.quote: Over CY26-28, we aim for a revenue CAGR of 15%, while maintaining an EBITDA margin in the vicinity of 18.5%, which we achieved in 2025.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 19.5% in Q3 CY26, up from 18.5% in CY25
items.quote: EBITDA grew 38% to INR1,289 million, a margin of 19.5%.

items.statement: Margin improvement driven by localization, productivity, scale, product mix, pricing actions and forex benefits
items.quote: There are many factors behind that, localization, productivity improvement, scale efficiency, all design product mix, all this contributed to the growth that we are seeing now.

items.statement: Margin guidance of 18.5% for next two years reflects expected normalization of forex and commodity pass-through
items.quote: That is why we given 18.5% as a guidance for next two years.

items.statement: Broad-based demand across all three verticals with highest ever quarterly revenue in each
items.quote: Each of the three verticals, industrial automation, off-highway mobility, and wind, recorded highest ever quarterly revenue, a sign of resilient demand environment across our end industries.

items.statement: Industrial automation benefiting from manufacturing recovery across 22 industries
items.quote: Industrial automation is benefiting from a broad recovery in manufacturing in India, because we are market leaders there.

items.statement: New program wins contributing 5% of nine-month off-highway revenue
items.quote: I would say that of the total business nine months, 5% is coming from new programs.

items.statement: Wind program wins in Europe compensating for GE de-growth
items.quote: That also includes some of the program wins in Europe. That will continue to play out in coming years as well.

items.statement: Capex of INR 1,000 million planned for CY26 and INR 1,500 million for CY27
items.quote: The company plans to do a capex of around INR 1,000 million in current year 2026 and INR1,500 million in current year 2027 towards building capacity to support future growth.

items.statement: Capex funded entirely from internal accruals, no borrowing planned
items.quote: Entire funding will come with the internal accrual as we are positive cash company. We do not see any need for any borrowing.

items.statement: Heavy-duty gearbox plant to start in H1 2027 at Talegaon, Pune on 25-acre land
items.quote: We will start manufacturing in first half of 2027, with intent to complete in one year time.

items.statement: Mannur plant lease renewed for 3 years with 6-month notice; operations to shift to Talegaon by H2 2028
items.quote: We renewed the Mannur rental agreement for three years with notice period of six months, which means we can give a notice period of six months and vacate the premises.

items.statement: Phased price actions taken; commodity cost pass-through incomplete due to inventory lag and supplier negotiations
items.quote: We have seen commodity price increase in the market, and we went and took some sales actions, phased price actions. While price increase is visible in the book, cost is not as fully passed through because of inventory and supplier negotiation is still going on.

items.statement: Export growth driven by Germany, UK, Spain; supply chain diversification from China benefiting India
items.quote: U.S. used to be our number one geography, which used to be 58% of our total exports. But they come down to 48% in this year's nine months, while other geographies have gone up, especially Germany, U.K., Spain.

items.statement: Seven of top 10 OEMs have relationships exceeding 10 years
items.quote: Seven out of top 10 OEMs have been with us for more than 10 years.

items.statement: Exports to group entities ~21% of revenue; balance exports direct to customers
items.quote: Exports to group entities around 21%, and 30.6% is the total exports.

items.statement: Competition differs by segment: SEW, NORD, Premium in industrial automation; Comer, Dana, PMP in off-highway
items.quote: In industrial automation, we are competing mainly from European players like SEW, NORD, Premium, etcetera. In off-highway, we have different set of competition like Comer, Dana, PMP, etcetera.

items.statement: Market share: 25% in industrial automation, 32% in off-highway mobility, >50% in wind drives among domestic manufacturers
items.quote: We are number one in all the three verticals, about 25% market share in low and medium-duty gearboxes for industrial automation segment, about 32% in off-highway mobility drives, and more than 50% in wind drives among domestic manufacturers.

items.statement: 35% of H1 CY26 revenue from products launched in last three years
items.quote: Approximately 35% of our business in CY26 first half is coming from new products that we introduced in the last three years.

items.statement: Heavy-duty gearbox entry expected to contribute meaningfully post CY28
items.quote: Heavy duty will start contributing post CY 2028, meaningfully to our business.

items.statement: Inventory lag and supplier negotiations delaying full commodity cost pass-through
items.quote: While price increase is visible in the book, cost is not as fully passed through because of inventory and supplier negotiation is still going on.

items.statement: Net cash balance sheet maintained; no borrowing needed for capex
items.quote: With the leadership across all three verticals, net cash balance sheet, and strong return ratios, we are confident of achieving our targets while maintaining healthy margins.

items.statement: Royalty fixed at 6% on specified products; effective rate 4.4-4.5% of sales; no plans to change
items.quote: We have a fixed rate of 6% royalty on specified products, and effective royalty works out to 4.4%, 4.5% of our sales, more or less. In the last many years, we keep this ratio unchanged, I can say that. We do not expect this ratio to get changed in the coming periods unless any big change in royalty agreement.

items.statement: ~70% materials sourced domestically from 150+ suppliers; localization enhancing cost competitiveness
items.quote: Our manufacturing facilities are built on Industry 4.0 principles, with approximately 70% of materials sourced domestically. We work with over 150 suppliers.

items.statement: Forex benefits and commodity price timing may not repeat; margin expected to temper down
items.quote: The forex is another important advantage that we had in this year compared to previous year. I think some of these benefits may not repeat in coming quarters.

items.statement: GE Wind de-growth of 30% in 9M CY26 offset by 22% growth from other wind customers
items.quote: GE was our biggest customer in 2025, and we had a degrowth of 30% compared to 2025, 2026 up to nine months. However, other customers grew by 22%.

items.statement: Global sugar market expected to shift from 1.1 MMT surplus in SY25-26 to 0.2 MMT deficit in SY26-27
items.quote: Global sugar market is expected to move from a surplus of approximately 1.1 million metric tons (MMT) in '25-'26 to a marginal deficit of around 0.2 MMT in '26-'27, as global production moderates to about 180 MMT, while consumption increases to approximately 180.4 MMT.

items.statement: India sugar year 2025-26 balance sheet: 31 MMT production, 3.1 MMT ethanol diversion, 28.5 MMT consumption, 0.8 MMT exports, 3.7 MMT closing stock
items.quote: The sugar year (SY) '25-'26, domestic sugar balance sheet is as follows; gross production is 31 MMT, diversion to ethanol is 3.1 MMT, domestic consumption 28.5 MMT, and exports 0.8 MMT, resulting in a closing stock of 3.7 MMT.

items.statement: India likely to import sugar in SY26-27 due to lower cane yields in Karnataka and Maharashtra from subpar monsoon
items.quote: It is quite likely that India will need to import sugar in SY '26-'27 so as to bridge the gap.

items.statement: EID Parry estimates 10% lower cane crop for next year
items.quote: Our estimate is about a 10% lower crop for next year. That's the estimate.

items.statement: Ethanol volumes expected at 14-15 crore litres for current year
items.quote: This year could trend anywhere between 14 crores litres to 15 crores litres.

items.statement: Ethanol volumes guided at 14-14.5-15 crore litres for this year and subsequent years
items.quote: About 14 crores litres to 14.5 crores litres to 15 crores litres is what we will be doing this year and in the subsequent years.

items.statement: Consumer products segment targeting INR500 crore revenue in FY27 and 20-25% growth in FY28
items.quote: In a TV interview today, you said the consumer business should end at INR500 crores of revenue this year and then 20% to 25% growth next year.

items.statement: Consumer products segment break-even targeted for FY28
items.quote: FY28 is when we are looking at a break-even for that segment.

items.statement: Overall FY27 estimated at par with FY26 for combined sugar, distillery and co-gen
items.quote: We would estimate an at par year compared to last year.

items.statement: Subpar southwest monsoon, lower inventories and seasonal demand elevated sugar prices in Q2
items.quote: During Q2 of this year, a subpar southwest monsoon, lower inventories, and a seasonal demand, elevated sugar prices, although subsequent government interventions, including duty-free raw sugar imports, tighter dealer stock limits, and more frequent quota allocations have helped improve availability and moderate ex-mill prices towards the end of the quarter.

items.statement: Karnataka season expected to be shorter by 10-15 days due to El Nino impact on water levels
items.quote: Karnataka, the current estimate is, we have had a late start of about 8-10 days. We expect the season to be shorter anywhere between 10-15 days. This is not related to sowing, but related to the crop availability basis the water levels, etcetera. This has been an El Nino impacted year, and we see that impacting Karnataka.

items.statement: Sowing impact estimated at 8-10% downside in Karnataka due to dam water levels
items.quote: Right now, the estimate may be anywhere between 8%-10%, which will impact next year.

items.statement: Tamil Nadu cane volumes trending 8-10% higher this year
items.quote: From a cane volume perspective, obviously this year Tamil Nadu has so far trended about 8%-10% higher cane volumes.

items.statement: Karnataka margins better than Tamil Nadu; Tamil Nadu cost of production higher but higher sugar prices help both regions
items.quote: From a margin perspective, very clearly Karnataka is where the margins are. Tamil Nadu, your cost of production is higher, but obviously the higher sugar prices will help in both the regions.

items.statement: Consumer products CM1 margins significantly improved through purposeful recalibration
items.quote: Contribution margins 1 (CM1) have significantly moved up.

items.statement: VAP saliency increased from 16% to 28% in current quarter
items.quote: The Value Added Products (VAP) saliency increased from 16% to 28% in the current quarter.

items.statement: Cane price in North Karnataka around INR3,800 per MT vs FRP of INR3,300-3,400
items.quote: Right now, I think largely in parts of Northern Karnataka, the cane price is around INR3,800, is what the companies seem to be committing to the farmers.

items.statement: Cane landed cost increased to INR3,798 per MT from INR3,620 per MT YoY
items.quote: Cane landed cost is about INR3,798 per MT, as against the INR3,620 per MT in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

items.statement: Sugar realization increased to INR45.11 per kg from INR40.67 per kg YoY
items.quote: As far as the realization is concerned, we realized about INR45.11 per kg, as against the INR40.67 per kg in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

items.quote: As far as the realization is concerned, we realized about INR63.99 per litre on an average, as against the INR67.55 per litre in the corresponding period of the previous year.

items.quote: As far as the power tariff is concerned, it stood at INR3.73 per unit as against INR4.04 per unit in the corresponding period of the previous year.

items.statement: Nutraceuticals growth driven by pet joint health and derm/hair care segments with new product launches
items.quote: The growth drivers in the recent quarters, which we have seen, are largely coming from the pet health side, pet joint health, and from the derm side, wherein we have some new product launches.

items.statement: Avoiding long-term sugar contracts due to price volatility; 96-97% of long-term contracts completed, future contracts 15-24 days mirroring spot prices
items.quote: We have in the last six months, due to the volatility of the pricing scenario, tend to avoid longer-term contracts. We have just almost nearly 96-97% completed all our long-term contracts. As we go forward, we'll be cautious on the long-term contracts because we expect price volatility to continue in this segment. items.statement: No capex or inorganic plans in sugar and biofuel segments; focus on running existing operations effectively
items.quote: There are no capex or inorganic plans in the sugar and biofuel side. I think we have a large span of operations, so focus is on really running them effectively.

items.statement: Consumer products business needs op-ex investment in A&SP, manpower and new product development, not capex
items.quote: While this business doesn't need capex, it is needing an op-ex in a sense in its A&SP program, in building the right skill sets around manpower and in new product development.

items.statement: No capital allocation plans for nutraceuticals segment
items.quote: On the Nutra front, we are not seeing any capital allocation plans.

items.statement: Refinery physical assets divestment underway to strengthen standalone balance sheet
items.quote: We're going through the motions with the divestment of all the physical assets of the refinery. I think all of this is being done to strengthen the company's core and standalone balance sheet, and that really will enable us to grow further.

items.statement: PSRIPL SEZ exit formalities in progress; final duty payment expected in Q3, then asset monetization to begin
items.quote: As far as the unit's SEZ exit formalities are concerned, we got the in principle exit letter sometime in April, and we submitted all the workings relating to the duty payment in June. We are expecting the final payment of duty in Q3. As far as the assets and the monetization are concerned, once the SEZ and environmental clearance is completed, we will start monetizing the assets.

items.statement: No buyback discussions at this point
items.quote: No such discussion at this point, Rajakumar.

items.quote: On the back of intense farmer agitations in Karnataka and Maharashtra, a committee of experts has been constituted to examine the demands of the farmers. items.statement: Distillery produced 307 LL vs 392 LL YoY; sold 440 LL (212 LL ENA, 234 LL ethanol) vs 409 LL YoY
items.quote: As far as the distillery operations are concerned, we produced about 307 lakh litres (LL) during the quarter, as against the 392 LL in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. items.statement: Co-gen generated 385 LU vs 307 LU YoY; exported 175 LU vs 128 LU YoY
items.quote: As far as the co-gen operations concerned, we generated about 385 lakh units (LU) as against the 307 LU in the corresponding period of the previous year. We have exported about 175 LU as against 128 LU in the corresponding period of the previous year.

items.quote: we remain confident of achieving our guided revenue and EBITDA growth of around 30% for the full year

items.quote: first year, I think we started in July this facility, and we are running at a capacity of around 30% to 35% odd as of now. Going forward, this capacity shall be increased to 70% in FY28, and maybe we can reach earlier that capacity also, and by FY28, we will go 100%

items.statement: Egypt aseptic plant to reach 30% utilization year 1, 60% year 2, 100% year 3
items.quote: First year, we'll do a capacity of around 30%. Next year, we'll reach around 60% capacity, and third year, we'll reach around 100% capacity

items.statement: Overall capacity utilization around 80%, targeting 90%+
items.quote: Now the capacity utilization is running at around 80%. If the capacity utilization was little lower, then our expenses will be higher

items.statement: Q2 FY27 normalized EBITDA margin 15.6%, up 550 bps YoY
items.quote: Normalized EBITDA increased 95% year-on-year to Rs.7,588 million, with normalized EBITDA margin expanding by 550 basis points to 15.6%

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin sustainable at 14-15%, driven 60% by overseas margins
items.quote: blended margin, overseas plus India, you see we are in the range of 14% to 15%. And that margin is very sustainable going forward also

items.statement: BOPET film spread consistent at Rs.25-35/kg over last 9 months
items.quote: It has ranged from Rs.25 to Rs.35 spread, basically. You can see the spread is in that range, and it is for over nine months

items.statement: Raw material cost pass-through contracts maintain consistent spreads despite crude volatility
items.quote: Most of our contracts are designed in such a way that all the fluctuation in the key raw materials are passed on to the customers. That's why our spread, what you see across the last 3-4 quarters, have been maintained

items.statement: Value-added products at 30% of sales, targeting 50% by FY29

But apart from that, only pure spare parts and service, it would be roug

items.quote: We expect to close the year at what has been a broad basis, 15% growth in the HPC. I think we are pretty much on course to achieve that.

items.quote: This transfer of lease rights to the land in M.P. that has happened from Patanjali Ayurved, this INR185 crores that we are paying seems to be quite substantial.

items.quote: And this year, we have done 10.39 lakh tons (error: actual number is 11.07 lakh tons), which is 10.5% growth in volume terms, and about 99,000 sort of tons additional volume that we did.

items.quote: So, we grew from 49,000 (to be read as 49,874) tons in the previous quarter, Q1 of FY27, to 56,122 tons of what we sold.

items.quote: Our parent company, Patanjali Ayurved Limited, already had this land from the MPSIDC, and to the tune of 42.5 acres. For this purpose only, we have taken this land on lease.

items.quote: As of September 26, our order book stands at approximately INR5,056 crores, which gives us strong visibility on revenue going forward. items.quote: On order inflows, we remain on track with our guidance of INR5,000 crores for this financial year. The water segment went through a phase of consolidation in H1, but tenders have now started picking up.

Profit after tax was INR22.2 crores, up 46% year-on-year basis with a PAT margin of 9.3%.

items.statement: New order book projects carry expected operating margins of 10% or higher; legacy orders at lower margins but back-to-back subcontracted
items.quote: Only around INR1,161 crores of orders are related to legacy projects, while the balance consists predominantly of the projects carrying expected operating margins of 10% or higher.

items.quote: The 3 sectors water, BESS and power has a huge, huge opportunity. And all these sectors are having the clear visibility of next 5 to 7 years.

items.statement: NTPC BESS order INR1,128 crores progressing well; design and drawing approvals received; revenue expected from H2 FY27, around INR300 crores in FY27
items.quote: Our INR1,128 crores BESS order from NTPC is progressing well. We have received design and drawing approvals, which is an important milestone. With this in place, we expect revenue from the project to start flowing in the second half of this financial year.

items.quote: Recently, in the power sector, we have been awarded a INR186 crores contract by Power Grid Corporation of India for the extension of Bhadla-III and Ramgarh Substation in Rajasthan.

items.statement: H1 FY27 operating cash flow INR82.4 crores vs outflow of INR44.1 crores in H1 FY26; cash and equivalents up 88% to INR119 crores

items.quote: Legacy order will get completed into this financial year and next financial year and with the more contribution from the new orders, the margin % will keep on improving which you see the margin trend of from last 3 quarters.

items.statement: Project selection discipline: prioritizing fully funded projects in cash-rich states with design approvals in place; structural change driving sustained positive operating cash flow
items.quote: When the project is fully funded and the major design and drawing approvals are in place, cash flow remains healthy throughout execution. As our order book increasingly consists of such projects, we expect positive operating cash flow to be sustained in the future.

items.statement: BESS container manufacturing facility to supply containers for NTPC order and all future BESS orders; facility completion expected H1 FY28
items.quote: We will supply part of the containers for our NTPC order from our own plant. For all future BESS orders, we intend to source containers entirely from our in-house facility.

items.statement: Differentiation in BESS: proprietary 104.4 kWh battery pack design with international certification, domestic manufacturing, Energy Vault partnership, full project integration capability
items.quote: Our differentiation lies in our own 104.4 kWh battery pack design, which has clearly international certification and domestic manufacturing at Pune and the ability to integrate the execute the full project supported by our partnership with Energy Vault.

items.statement: Focus on quality orders from financially strong states; selective bidding with minimum 10% profit margin threshold; not pursuing fixed-price or unclear funding projects
items.quote: We are also not keen to pursue projects unless the profit margin is atleast 10%. So, we are very selective in our bidding but there are so much opportunities coming into all these sectors.

items.statement: Government may face near-term liquidity pressure but structural demand in water, power, BESS too strong; company confident of securing INR5,000 crores orders in FY27
items.quote: So, while the government may face some liquidity pressure in the near term, however we expect a substantial flow of orders to continue across water, power and BESS sectors. We are also deliberately selective in what we bid for.

items.statement: Arun Agarwal promoted to Chief Financial Officer
items.quote: Mr. Arun Agarwal, sir, who has been promoted to the position of Chief Financial Officer. Congratulations to him on the new role.

items.statement: H1 FY27 revenue INR505 crores up 45% YoY; EBITDA INR55 crores up 33% YoY; PAT INR45 crores up 64% YoY
items.quote: For the first half, revenue was INR505 crores, up 45% on a year-on-year basis. EBITDA stand at INR55 crores, up 33% year-on-year basis and PAT is up 64% at INR45 crores.

items.statement: EPC to O&M ratio ~95:5 in projects; O&M higher margin than EPC; O&M value varies by order
items.quote: O&M is normally remained with high-margin element. But the value of the O&M depends on order to order. But you can take a percentage of 95:5 in the EPC project and O&M value in each order. O&M is always profitable more compared to EPC.

items.statement: FY27 guidance unchanged at 25% growth; H2 expected to exceed H1 on revenue and profitability due to monsoon constraints in H1
items.quote: We expect this year to follow the same trend with H2 contribution more than H1 on both revenue and profitability cumulatively, which will overall improve our guidance on both top line and bottom line.

items.statement: CV industry expected to grow double-digit to mid-teens for full year FY27
items.quote: We think that already November, we are seeing that the sentiment is very positive in our customers in various segments, and we think this will carry forward to the whole year. As far as the numbers are concerned, for the year, we do think that it will be double digit. We also think that it could go to mid-teen kind of a growth for the whole year for the CV industry, especially M&HCV I am talking a

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 is INR1,000-1,200 crores
items.quote: I think the capex so far for H1 is close to INR400 crores on a cumulative basis, and we do hope that it will go to INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores for the whole year. So, that is that.

items.statement: Price increase of 100-150 bps planned in Q3 FY27, another likely in Q4 FY27
items.quote: In Q3 also, we are trying to take about 100 to 150 basis points of price increase. Q4, we will go ahead with one more, most likely, and then we will see how the situation is at end of this fiscal.

items.statement: Domestic M&HCV industry grew 39% YoY, LCV industry grew 24% YoY in Q2 FY27
items.quote: The domestic M&HCV industry r ecorded volume growth of 39% year-on-year during the quarter, while the domestic LCV industry grew by 24

items.statement: October industry volumes strong on higher base, positive sentiment across segments
items.quote: Now, we all know the October numbers for the industry, and we are very positive to see October numbers, because even on a higher base, October numbers stand very good, both on the M&HCV side and the LCV side. So, that is giving us a lot of strength in our outlook for the rest of the year.

items.statement: Replacement demand driven by TCO advantage of BS6 trucks over older BS2/BS3/BS4 trucks
items.quote: But also the fact that people have now realized that they can't afford to keep their older trucks on the road anymore, because they have clearly determined or understood that the TCO for a newer BS6 truck is far better than a TCO of a BS2, BS3, or BS4 truck.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 10.1% in Q2 FY27, flat QoQ but down 200 bps YoY due to commodity inflation
items.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 10.1%, at the same level as Q1 FY27, and lower compared with 12.1% in Q2 of FY26.

items.statement: Material cost rose to 74.9% of revenue in Q2 FY27 from 71.5% in Q1 FY27, up 340 bps QoQ
items.quote: Material cost as a percentage of revenue increased to 74.9% compared with 71.5% in Q1 of this year, an increase of 340 basis points quarte r-on-quarter

items.statement: Net sale realization increased 1-1.25% per quarter, up 2-2.5% since start of FY27
items.quote: We have been consistent enough in raising the net sale realization anywhere between 1%-1.25% every quarter, so that way, you can clearly see that the prices have gone up. From the year beginning, it has gone up by about 2%-2.5%.

items.statement: Switch Mobility order book at ~2,800 e-buses as of September 2026
items.quote: Now, its order book stood at approximately 2,800 e-buses at the end of September 2026.

items.statement: Defence order book and tender pipeline remain strong
items.quote: The Defence order book and the tender pipeline remain strong, providing healthy visibility for the future.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 capex INR240 crores, H1 cumulative INR393 crores; subsidiary investments INR472 crores in Q2, H1 total INR483 crores
items.value: INR240 crores, INR393 crores, INR472 crores, INR483 crores
items.quote: Capex for the quarter was INR240 crores, taking cumulative capex for the first half to INR393 crores. Investment in subsidiaries was INR472 cr ores, taking first half total to INR483 crores

items.statement: INR324 crores invested for Switch UK loan repayment and INR150 crores in OHM e-mobility subsidiary in Q2 FY27
items.quote: During the quarter, INR324 crores of invest ments were made for repayment of Switch UK loan and INR150 crores in OHM, our e-mobility subsidiary

items.statement: Battery pack facility at Pillaipakkam approved, construction started, SOP expected Q3 FY28
items.quote: I am also happy to report that all approvals are now in place for our new battery pack facility at Pillaipakkam near Chennai. The construction wo rk has started, and start of production is expected to start in Q3 of next year

items.statement: Freight cost per vehicle up >50% YoY due to diesel prices and transporter demand
items.quote: I can tell you that if you compare like a percentage of our freight cost that the trucks and buses we move from our factories to the dealers, that has gone up by more than 50% per vehicle over last one year or so.

items.statement: Multi-axle vehicle share of truck volumes rose from 20% in Q1 to 25% in Q2 FY27
items.quote: We are seeing a strong increase here on the multi-axle vehicle side. Multi-axle vehicle volumes have gone up. The share of the multi-axle vehicles with reference to the overall volume, truck volume, has gone up by about 5% in Q2. It was 20% in Q1, it has gone up to 25%.

items.statement: Network expanded by 43 touchpoints in Q2 FY27, total 2,175 touchpoints (1,205 M&HCV, 970 LCV)
items.quote: We added more touchpoints during the quarter. The new addition was 43 touchpoints in M&HCV and LCV businesses. The focus of new additions continues in north and east regions, where we have higher headroom. At the end of the quarter, Ashok Leyland network has a total of 2,175 touchpoints, 1,205 for M&HCV and 970 for LCV.

items.statement: Net cash surplus INR3,546 crores at end-September 2026, positive swing of INR2,556 crores YoY
items.quote: Our cash position, net of debt, stood at a surplus of INR3,546 crores at the end of September 2026, a positive swing of INR2,556 crores year-on-year.

items.statement: Board recommended interim dividend of INR1 per share on face value INR1
items.quote: Against this backdrop, the board has recommended an interim dividend of INR1 per share on face value of INR1 per share, reflecting confidence in the business and our commitment to consistently returning value to shareholders while continuing to invest for long-term growth.

items.statement: Ashok Leyland to consolidate NDL/HLF on cost accounting basis, ignoring fair value adjustments; consolidated book value INR8,313 crores, PAT INR174 crores for Q2 FY27
items.quote: Ashok Leyland and its statutory auditors, PwC, after due consultations, have decided to consolidate the financials of NDL or HLF in Ashok Leyland on cost accounting basis, thus ignoring all fair value or purchase price adjustments. Consolidated book value of Hinduja Leyland Finance and Hinduja Housing Finance, as reflected in Ashok Leyland consolidated results, stood at INR8,313 crores with a PAT

items.quote: at 32.1%, representing an improvement of 120 basis points year-on-year.
